# anchor argv with --dsa-prefill-backend flashmla_sparse_q8, chunk 8192), and its engine_image /
# config_variant (-v12-q8) labels; r4 equals r4 of the v12 fleet file. Deploy it ONLY to gpu04, scoped
# to that one service; roll back by redeploying prod/GLM-5.3-Flash-SGL-TP2x4-W4AFP8.yaml for the same service.
# Runbook: docs/glm53-base-v12-q8-rollout.md.
#
# GLM-5.3 Flash BASE TIER, v7 FLEET CONFIG (gpu03 and gpu04): the one base config every host of the tier deploys.
# All four replicas r1-r4 run the glm53-hicache-w4afp8-v7 image (#345) with FP8 KV (flashmla_kv prefill and decode),
# 64 running requests / 64 decode graphs / 380 mamba slots, the overlap scheduler off, HiCache OFF (the form gpu03 r3
# runs: the four HiCache flags are removed, nothing else about HiCache changes), the preprocess pool and the
# tool-schema caps, and no profiling (no NEAR_SELF_PROFILE*). Runbook and evidence: docs/glm53-v7-fleet-rollout.md.
# ROLLBACK (v7): redeploy the previous tag's copy of this file for the same services; it is the v6 image
# (docker.io/nearaidev/sglang@sha256:9c6ddd4319c4ab00e351d8650459e68b8830e36ffcc029d67fa5e19d0ac3ed17) with bf16 KV, 48 running and HiCache on.
#
# Everything below this block describes the 4x TP2 layout and the history of its config; the engine argv, image and
# telemetry labels are the v7 ones above wherever the older text names bf16, 48 running, 330 slots or HiCache.
#
# GLM-5.3 Flash base-tier 4x TP2 file (one 8x H200 host: gpu03 or gpu04), generated from
# prod/GLM-5.3-Flash-SGL-TP4-W4AFP8.yaml by scripts/prepare_glm53_w4afp8_tp2x4.py.
# Four independent TP2/EP2 replicas, one per NVLink GPU pair (0-1, 2-3, 4-5, 6-7), replace
# the two TP4/EP4 replicas. Same checkpoint (graphistry/GLM-5.3-Flash-W4AFP8@99f1fa7) and
# the same admission reserve (4096, max fraction 0.75), plus 8192-token prefill chunks
# (the lab-qualified TP2 argv), a HiCache write_through_selective 325 GiB host tier per replica
# (4 x 325 GiB; OFF in the v7 fleet config) and the DSA indexer split. All four pin the v7 image:
#   docker.io/nearaidev/sglang@sha256:fa730e6e62b2ae8058114ce540487ade33ab93bc42b1179ae78edc92bd563fc5
# (docker/sglang-glm53-hicache-w4afp8 glm53-hicache-w4afp8-v7; #345, publish run 37693106399, main 29a7db9).
#
# EVIDENCE (lab, gpu31/gpu32, CC off, 2026-10-01; 1,300 GiB DRAM per 8 GPUs in both arms;
# base-tier synth traffic from the 2026-09-17 prod snapshot, least-conn + affinity router):
#   - Peak served throughput per 8 GPUs: 4xTP2 8.18 req/s / 1,871 output tok/s vs 2xTP4
#     6.49 req/s / 1,545 tok/s (+26% / +21%). Unserved backlog 4.7% vs 18% at 8 req/s
#     offered, 16% vs 37% at 10 req/s. 0 HTTP errors in every arm.
#   - Lower TTFT for prompts <=10K at every load. Long prompts (30K+) are slower at low load:
#     TP2 prefills with half the GPUs.
#   - Hit rate unchanged: 84-85% synth; agent-trace replay 93.1% (4xTP2) vs 93.2% (2xTP4)
#     at 96 agents.
#   - TP2: 81.7 GiB weights per GPU, 1.08M-token VRAM KV pool per replica, and a 5.87M-token
#     DRAM tier per replica at 325 GiB.
#   - write_through_selective (vs write_through) cut recomputed tokens 17-25% on the replay
#     with no throughput/ITL cost.
#   - Running cap: 165 mamba state slots with BF16 SSM state (--max-mamba-cache-size 165
#     --mamba-ssm-dtype bfloat16) let each TP2 replica run 32 requests instead of 15, with a
#     1.0M-token VRAM pool and a 5.4M-token DRAM tier. Lab at 10 req/s offered per 8 GPUs vs
#     the 15-running canary: 8.83 vs 7.74 req/s served (+14%), 2,064 vs 1,771 output tok/s
#     (+16%), TTFT p50/p90 0.39/3.20 vs 1.60/5.56 s, backlog 228 vs 925, hit rate 76.8% vs
#     71.5%. Cost: TPOT p90 188 vs 70 ms (bigger decode batches). Saturates at ~8.8 req/s.
#
# MEMORY-OPTIMIZED CONFIG (docs/glm53-base-tier-memopt-canary.md): all four replicas run the
# candidate argv (mem 0.86, EAGLE fixed 4/1/5, 330 mamba slots, 48 running, pdi 2; tee-bench exp
# 25/25b/25c), promoted from the r3/r4 canary after the gpu03 same-host bake on 2026-10-06. On
# gpu32 bare metal under overload it served +16% (1.75 conv/s) / +25% (2.5 conv/s) more requests.
#
# GATES before any deploy (docs/glm53-tp2x4-base-canary.md): (1) quality with BF16 mamba
# state at parity - PASSED 2026-10-02 (GSM8K 97.8% vs 97.4% FP32 state, perception 7/7); (2) a prod-CVM
# test on a drained host agreed with Lloyd: CC-on startup of 4 x 325 GiB pinned host tiers
# (cudaMallocHost), TP2 NCCL under PPCIe, CVM MemAvailable headroom, cold-start time;
# (3) the image already pulled on the host; (4) Pranav + Lloyd go.
#
# None of the four engine names exists in the TP4 file (and vice versa): stop the old
# engines with a scoped compose/down first; never let --remove-orphans do the switch.
# ROLLBACK: prod/GLM-5.3-Flash-SGL-TP4-W4AFP8.yaml, under the same orphan rule.
#
# OBSERVABILITY: all four replicas enable the opt-in ghost prefix cache in shared mode
# (SGLANG_GHOST_CACHE_REPLICA r1-r4, one key and socket on the in-memory ghost volume) and
# the KV tier metrics; the glm53-ghost-aggregator sidecar pools the four replicas' digests
# and is scraped like the engines. Both need the glm53-hicache-w4afp8-v6 image pinned here
# (older images ignore the engine variables, and the sidecar would exit).
# r1 inherits the anchor environment; r2-r4 repeat it with their own replica name (a YAML
# merge key replaces a list wholesale).
# Do not hand-edit this file.
# 4x TP2 variant of the W4AFP8 GLM-5.3 Flash base-tier deployment for one 8x H200 canary
# host: four independent TP2/EP2 replicas, one per NVLink GPU pair, behind one inference
# proxy.
x-logging-conf: &logging-conf
  driver: "json-file"
  options:
    max-size: "100m"
    max-file: "10"
    labels: "com.datadoghq.ad.logs,com.docker.compose.service"

# GLM-5.3-Flash on four independent H200 TP2/EP2 replicas. Each replica stays
# within one NVLink GPU pair; one inference-proxy uses its native
# least-connections backend pool for health-aware balancing and failover.
#
# The engine is published by the repository's GitHub Actions workflow and pinned here by
# its signed immutable registry digest. Its source is pinned to
# PierreLeGuen/sglang-upstream commit fc91d24, derived from official SGLang main plus
# the official GLM-5.3 branch. It contains upstream disconnect cleanup (#35255), the
# final-prefill abort fix (#34153), the strict thinking-budget adapter, and two narrow
# DSA import-cycle fixes. All four replicas pin the published split-capable
# docker/sglang-glm53-hicache-w4afp8 derivative the long tier runs (glm53-hicache-w4afp8-v6):
# the HCC-safe HiCache image (CUDA-owned host memory, carrying the opt-in chunked-prefill
# admission-reserve v10 patch, nearai/inference-optimizer@fb94472) plus the W4AFP8
# loader fix and the unconditional chunked-prefill pool clamp. The reserve is enabled
# below with SGLANG_CHUNKED_PREFILL_ADMISSION_RESERVE=4096,
# SGLANG_ADMISSION_RESERVE_MAX_FRACTION=0.75 and --prefill-decode-interval 1. The
# official CUDA 13 SGLang image is the pinned build base. The serving envelope is
# intentionally conservative: BF16 KV, 0.80 static memory, 32 running requests (an
# effective 32 per TP2 replica with 165 BF16 mamba state slots, see the file header), a
# bounded 8-request queue, 8192-token prefill chunks with --max-prefill-tokens 32768,
# decode graphs capped at batch 32, TileLang DSA, the CUTLASS W4A8 MoE path (hence no
# --moe-runner-backend and no FP8 --revision), and adaptive EAGLE 5/1/6. This retains
# the full 1,048,576-token model context.
# Priority scheduling (--enable-priority-scheduling, --disable-priority-preemption)
# relies on the pinned inference-proxy below (build 2834196, nearai/inference-proxy#241)
# overwriting the `priority` field of every forwarded request, so no client-chosen
# or missing priority ever reaches the scheduler. --default-priority-value is
# deliberately absent for the same reason. scripts/validate_glm53_prod_config.rb
# refuses the priority switches unless proxy-glm53 pins a priority-normalizing build.
#
# A small fail-closed adapter patch maps the public thinking_token_budget field
# to SGLang strict-thinking's custom_params.thinking_budget. Omitted values
# default to 8192; explicit null remains an opt-out; an explicit native
# custom_params.thinking_budget wins. Request/response payload logging is off.
#
# The vLLM GLM-5.3-Flash path is not used: its Hopper NVFP4/MLA path produced
# non-finite logits and repetitive output. This pack also retires the previous
# co-resident DeepSeek arm so both four-GPU islands serve GLM-5.3-Flash.

x-nvidia: &nvidia
  runtime: nvidia
  ipc: host
  ulimits:
    memlock: -1
    nofile:
      soft: 65535
      hard: 65535

x-vllm-proxy-common: &vllm-proxy-common
  image: nearaidev/vllm-proxy-rs@sha256:e4a42b327523e304c0fc389f656ba7a02fd7b3d4a38cdc822f9288fd193a525a
  user: root
  privileged: true
  <<: *nvidia
  extra_hosts:
    - "compose-manager:host-gateway"
  volumes:
    - /var/run/dstack.sock:/var/run/dstack.sock
    - certs:/etc/letsencrypt:ro
  restart: unless-stopped
  logging: *logging-conf

x-sg-glm53-flash-common: &sg-glm53-flash-common
  <<: *nvidia
  init: true
  image: docker.io/nearaidev/sglang@sha256:fa730e6e62b2ae8058114ce540487ade33ab93bc42b1179ae78edc92bd563fc5
  command: >
      sglang serve
      --model-path /root/.cache/huggingface/hub/models--graphistry--GLM-5.3-Flash-W4AFP8/snapshots/99f1fa70408c52b007d4fd69e02e5a522422e755
      --served-model-name z-ai/glm-5.3-flash
      --tp-size 2
      --ep-size 2
      --mem-fraction-static 0.80
      --max-running-requests 32
      --max-queued-requests 8
      --enable-priority-scheduling
      --disable-priority-preemption
      --chunked-prefill-size 8192
      --max-prefill-tokens 32768
      --prefill-decode-interval 1
      --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 32
      --dsa-prefill-backend tilelang
      --dsa-decode-backend tilelang
      --kv-cache-dtype bfloat16
      --speculative-algorithm EAGLE
      --speculative-num-steps 5
      --speculative-eagle-topk 1
      --speculative-num-draft-tokens 6
      --speculative-adaptive
      --reasoning-parser glm45
      --enable-strict-thinking
      --grammar-backend xgrammar
      --tool-call-parser glm47
      --chat-template /root/.cache/huggingface/hub/models--zai-org--GLM-5.3-Flash/snapshots/3f1971b7b5f7a528c9c4ef6212c8785298a8c24a/chat_template.jinja
      --context-length 1048576
      --dist-init-addr 127.0.0.1:29510
      --watchdog-timeout 1800
      --host 0.0.0.0
      --port 8000
      --enable-metrics
      --enable-cache-report
      --log-requests-level 0
      --disable-fast-image-processor
      --limit-mm-data-per-request '{"image": 64}'
      --enable-hierarchical-cache
      --hicache-write-policy write_through_selective
      --hicache-io-backend direct
      --hicache-mem-layout page_first_direct
      --max-mamba-cache-size 165
      --mamba-ssm-dtype bfloat16
  volumes:
    - kernel_cache:/root/.cache
    - huggingface_cache:/root/.cache/huggingface
    - ghost:/ghost
  environment:
    - HF_TOKEN=${HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN}
    # Local snapshot path; nothing is fetched at engine start.
    - HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
    - TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
    - HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1
    - DO_NOT_TRACK=1
    - NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES=compute,utility
    - OPENBLAS_L2_SIZE=2097152
    - NCCL_DEBUG=WARN
    - PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
    - TORCHINDUCTOR_CACHE_DIR=/root/.cache/torchinductor
    - TRITON_CACHE_DIR=/root/.cache/triton
    # Persist tilelang's DSA kernel JIT cache: it defaults to /root/.tilelang, outside
    # the kernel_cache volume, so every restart re-paid ~22-24 compiles at 8-9 s each
    # with the whole engine frozen (2026-09-12..16 capacity campaign).
    - TILELANG_CACHE_DIR=/root/.cache/tilelang
    # /health must not run a generation: at this pin health_generate submits a real
    # 1-token request that queues behind any in-flight long prefill, so the CVM
    # proxy's 3 s probe times out, the replica flaps unhealthy, and the conversation
    # affinity pin is skipped (full re-prefill on the other replica). nearai/infra#234.
    - SGLANG_ENABLE_HEALTH_ENDPOINT_GENERATION=0
    # Admission-reserve v10 (carried by this image): reserve up to 4096 tokens of each
    # 8192-token prefill chunk for waiting requests, sized on their uncached extend length,
    # bounded so the in-flight long prefill keeps >=25% of the chunk, and refunded when no
    # waiter used it. Pairs with --prefill-decode-interval 1 so admitted requests also decode.
    # Measured (2026-09-12..16 campaign): <=2K prompts p95 TTFT 19.6 s -> 0.6 s; cost ITL p90
    # 30 -> ~240 ms, median unchanged. The patch is inert with the reserve unset (rollback).
    # NEVER set SGLANG_ADMISSION_RESERVE_MIN_WAIT_S (wall-clock gate desyncs the TP ranks; v10
    # raises) or SGLANG_ADMISSION_RESERVE_MIN_ITERS (unmeasured in production).
    - SGLANG_CHUNKED_PREFILL_ADMISSION_RESERVE=4096
    - SGLANG_ADMISSION_RESERVE_MAX_FRACTION=0.75
    - SGLANG_ENABLE_STRICT_MEM_CHECK_DURING_IDLE=1
    # v7 fleet: HiCache is OFF (no --enable-hierarchical-cache in the argv), so the HiCache variables below are
    # unread, exactly as gpu03 r3 runs. They stay so re-enabling is an argv-only change.
    # HiCache host tier: a fixed 325 GiB per replica across its two TP ranks, 1,300 GiB for
    # the four replicas (the lab arm's DRAM total per 8 GPUs; ~5.87M tokens per replica). A
    # percentage would resolve against MemAvailable at each start, so the replicas started
    # later would get less; startup fails if it exceeds available RAM minus 10 GiB.
    - SGLANG_HICACHE_RAM_BUDGET=${GLM53_HICACHE_RAM_BUDGET:-325GiB}
    # CUDA-owned host memory (cudaMallocHost). Must stay 1 on TEE hosts: 0 selects
    # cudaHostRegister, which fails with CUDA error 801 under HCC/PPCIe.
    - SGLANG_HICACHE_CUDA_HOST_MEMORY=${GLM53_HICACHE_CUDA_HOST_MEMORY:-1}
    - SGLANG_HICACHE_POOLED_TRANSFERS=1
    - SGLANG_HICACHE_STAGING_PAGES=64
    # DSA indexer query split. Each TP rank scores 1/TP of a prefill chunk's rows instead of
    # all of them, so the fp32 logits buffer -- sized new_tokens x total_context -- shrinks
    # by TP (halves at TP2). gpu02's long-tier r1 crashed on 2026-09-25 without it:
    # deep_gemm.fp8_mqa_logits asked for 11.96 GiB with 11.88 GiB free at ~392K context
    # (dsa_indexer_kpool.py:919). This is a MITIGATION, not the fix: it divides the buffer
    # by TP and does not bound it. The real fix is calling _should_chunk_mqa_logits
    # (defined, unused, at dsa_indexer_kpool.py:862) and chunking against free memory.
    - SGLANG_DSA_INDEXER_QSPLIT=1
    # Opt-in observability (docker/sglang-glm53-hicache-w4afp8 v6; older images ignore it).
    # TP rank 0 only, off the serving path. The ghost prefix cache hashes each finished
    # request's pages into keyed digests (a 1/16 sample; tokens never leave the engine)
    # on a background thread and exports sglang:ghost_*. Every engine in this CVM shares the
    # key on the in-memory ghost volume and sends its digests to glm53-ghost-aggregator,
    # without ever blocking: if the aggregator is down the sends are dropped and counted.
    # The KV tier metrics export sglang:kv_tier_* (VRAM/DRAM evictions, load-backs, tier sizes).
    - SGLANG_GHOST_CACHE=1
    - SGLANG_GHOST_CACHE_SAMPLE=16
    - SGLANG_GHOST_CACHE_KEY_FILE=/ghost/key
    - SGLANG_GHOST_CACHE_SOCKET=/ghost/aggregator.sock
    - SGLANG_GHOST_CACHE_REPLICA=r1
    - SGLANG_KV_TIER_METRICS=1
    # v7 (opt-in in the image): the preprocess pool (SGLANG_PREPROCESS_WORKERS=0 is the old single-thread path)
    # and the tool-schema caps (0 = off). Profiling is off (no self-profile variables).
    - SGLANG_PREPROCESS_WORKERS=4
    - SGLANG_PREPROCESS_TIMEOUT_S=60
    - SGLANG_PREPROCESS_LOG_SLOW_S=5
    - SGLANG_TOOL_SCHEMA_MAX_DEPTH=32
    - SGLANG_TOOL_SCHEMA_MAX_NODES=25000
  restart: unless-stopped
  stop_grace_period: 5m
  logging: *logging-conf

x-sg-glm53-flash-candidate: &sg-glm53-flash-candidate
  # v7 fleet argv for every replica (tee-bench exp 25-32): the previous argv with mem 0.86, EAGLE fixed
  # 4/1/5 (no adaptive), FP8 KV with both DSA backends flashmla_kv, 64 running / graph batch 64, 380 mamba
  # slots (5 per running request), the overlap scheduler off, and HiCache OFF (the four HiCache flags are

      --served-model-name z-ai/glm-5.3-flash
      --tp-size 2
      --ep-size 2
      --mem-fraction-static 0.86
      --max-running-requests 64
      --max-queued-requests 32
      --enable-priority-scheduling
      --disable-priority-preemption
      --chunked-prefill-size 8192
      --max-prefill-tokens 32768
      --prefill-decode-interval 2
      --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 64
      --dsa-prefill-backend flashmla_kv
      --dsa-decode-backend flashmla_kv
      --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3
      --speculative-algorithm EAGLE
      --speculative-num-steps 4
      --speculative-eagle-topk 1
      --speculative-num-draft-tokens 5
      --reasoning-parser glm45
      --enable-strict-thinking
      --grammar-backend xgrammar
      --tool-call-parser glm47
      --chat-template /root/.cache/huggingface/hub/models--zai-org--GLM-5.3-Flash/snapshots/3f1971b7b5f7a528c9c4ef6212c8785298a8c24a/chat_template.jinja
      --context-length 1048576
      --dist-init-addr 127.0.0.1:29510
      --watchdog-timeout 1800
      --host 0.0.0.0
      --port 8000
      --enable-metrics
      --enable-cache-report
      --log-requests-level 0
      --disable-fast-image-processor

      --max-mamba-cache-size 380
      --mamba-ssm-dtype bfloat16
      --disable-overlap-schedule

x-dcgm-common: &dcgm-common
  image: nvcr.io/nvidia/k8s/dcgm-exporter@sha256:613ab03c11d442fd960ff515f547e9921537454a712d08160bc8f677f89f1c35
  command: ["-f", "/etc/dcgm-exporter/nearai-h200.csv"]
  runtime: nvidia
  cap_add:
    - SYS_ADMIN
  configs:
    - source: dcgm_h200_metrics
      target: /etc/dcgm-exporter/nearai-h200.csv
      mode: 0444
  restart: unless-stopped
  logging: *logging-conf

services:
  model-downloader:
    image: ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:python3.11-bookworm-slim@sha256:4f5d923c9dcea037f57bda425dd209f3ec643da2f0b74227f68d09dab0b3bb36
    container_name: model-downloader
    restart: "no"
    entrypoint: ["sh", "-c"]
    # Every dedicated GLM-5.3 Flash TP4 file (not prod/small-models.yaml) also fetches the
    # W4AFP8 snapshot (~165 GiB; keep >=250 GiB free on the model-cache volume), so moving
    # a host between the FP8 and W4AFP8 files costs only the engine cold start:
    # compose-manager runs `up --remove-orphans`, so a new file's downloader cannot run
    # while engines it does not define are still serving.
    command:
      - |
        set -e
        echo "Downloading zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash..."
        uvx --from 'huggingface_hub[hf_xet]' hf download zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash --revision 84c6a6aa9497188e15a635ba793b0f95a79b1033
        echo "Downloading corrected GLM-5.3-Flash chat template..."
        uvx --from 'huggingface_hub[hf_xet]' hf download zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash chat_template.jinja --revision 3f1971b7b5f7a528c9c4ef6212c8785298a8c24a
        echo "Downloading graphistry/GLM-5.3-Flash-W4AFP8..."
        uvx --from 'huggingface_hub[hf_xet]' hf download graphistry/GLM-5.3-Flash-W4AFP8 --revision 99f1fa70408c52b007d4fd69e02e5a522422e755
        echo "Download complete."
    volumes:
      - huggingface_cache:/root/.cache/huggingface
    environment:
      - HF_TOKEN=${HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN}
    logging: *logging-conf
    labels:
      com.datadoghq.ad.logs: '[{"source":"model-downloader","service":"model-downloader","tags":["model:zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash","served_model:z-ai/glm-5.3-flash","deployment:glm53-flash-sgl-tp2x4","env:${ENV}","host:${CVM_HOST}","ip:${HOST_IP}"]}]'

  # Dormant during normal deploys. Target this service explicitly with the
  # maintenance profile when one model's shared HF cache must be evicted.
  # Inlined copy of the root cleanup-hf-model.yaml service: compose-manager's
  # compose/up fetches only the requested file, so cross-file `extends:` /
  # `include:` must not be used here (they fail at config load).
  hf-cleanup:
    image: alpine:3.20@sha256:d9e853e87e55526f6b2917df91a2115c36dd7c696a35be12163d44e6e2a4b6bc
    container_name: hf-cleanup
    profiles: ["maintenance"]
    restart: "no"
    entrypoint: ["sh", "-c"]
    command:
      - |
        set -eu
        : "$${MODEL_NAME:?MODEL_NAME env var is required (e.g. zai-org/GLM-5-FP8)}"

        echo "=== Disk usage ==="
        df -h /root/.cache 2>/dev/null || df -h /

        echo ""
        echo "=== Cached model weights ==="
        HUB=/root/.cache/huggingface/hub
        if ls "$$HUB"/models--* >/dev/null 2>&1; then
          du -sh "$$HUB"/models--* | sort -rh
        else
          echo "(none)"
        fi
        echo ""
        echo "Total HF cache: $$(du -sh $$HUB 2>/dev/null | cut -f1)"

        echo ""
        echo "=== Cleanup ==="
        SAFE=$$(printf '%s' "$$MODEL_NAME" | sed 's|/|--|g')
        TARGET="$$HUB/models--$$SAFE"
        echo "MODEL_NAME=$$MODEL_NAME"
        echo "TARGET=$$TARGET"
        if [ ! -d "$$TARGET" ]; then
          echo "Not found — nothing to remove."
          exit 0
        fi
        echo "Removing $$(du -sh "$$TARGET" | cut -f1) ..."
        rm -rf "$$TARGET"
        echo "Removed $$TARGET"
        echo "Disk after: $$(df -h /root/.cache 2>/dev/null | tail -1 || df -h / | tail -1)"
    volumes:
      - huggingface_cache:/root/.cache/huggingface
    environment:
      - MODEL_NAME=${MODEL_NAME:-}
    # Verbatim from cleanup-hf-model.yaml (not the file-wide *logging-conf) so the
    # rendered service is unchanged from the previous `extends` result.
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"
        labels: "com.datadoghq.ad.logs"

  nginx:
    image: nginx@sha256:1d13701a5f9f3fb01aaa88cef2344d65b6b5bf6b7d9fa4cf0dca557a8d7702ba
    container_name: nginx
    depends_on:
      - proxy-glm53
    command: /bin/sh -c 'cert=/etc/letsencrypt/live/completions.near.ai/fullchain.pem; last=$$(stat -L -c %Y "$$cert" 2>/dev/null); while :; do sleep 60; cur=$$(stat -L -c %Y "$$cert" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$$cur" ] && [ "$$cur" != "$$last" ]; then last=$$cur; echo "$$cert changed, reloading nginx"; nginx -s reload; fi; done & while :; do sleep 6h; nginx -s reload; done & nginx -g "daemon off;"'
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
      - "8444:443"
    volumes:
      - certs:/etc/letsencrypt:ro
    configs:
      - source: nginx_conf
        target: /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
        mode: 0644
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging: *logging-conf
    labels:
      com.datadoghq.ad.logs: '[{"source":"nginx","service":"nginx","tags":["model:z-ai/glm-5.3-flash","deployment:glm53-flash-sgl-tp2x4","env:${ENV}","host:${CVM_HOST}","ip:${HOST_IP}","port:8000"]}]'

  model-proxy-registrar:
    image: curlimages/curl@sha256:d94d07ba9e7d6de898b6d96c1a072f6f8266c687af78a74f380087a0addf5d17
    container_name: model-proxy-registrar
    entrypoint: ["sh", "/register.sh"]
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      # Unhealthy if the registration loop hasn't ticked in 3m (e.g. wedged
      # before the loop, or the loop died). Surfaces silent registrar failures
      # in `docker ps` / Datadog. See cvm-compose-files#57.
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "[ $$(( $$(date +%s) - $$(cat /tmp/registrar_alive 2>/dev/null || echo 0) )) -lt 180 ]"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 1200s
    environment:
      - HOST_IP=${HOST_IP}
      - HTTP_PORT=${HTTP_PORT:-8000}
      - TLS_PORT=${TLS_PORT:-8444}
      - MODEL_PROXY_TOKEN=${MODEL_PROXY_TOKEN}
      - PROXY_TOKEN=${PROXY_TOKEN}
    configs:
      - source: registrar_script
        target: /register.sh
        mode: 0755
    logging: *logging-conf
    labels:
      com.datadoghq.ad.logs: '[{"source":"model-proxy-registrar","service":"model-proxy-registrar","tags":["model:z-ai/glm-5.3-flash","deployment:glm53-flash-sgl-tp2x4","env:${ENV}","host:${CVM_HOST}","ip:${HOST_IP}"]}]'

  # --- GLM-5.3-Flash proxy ---
  proxy-glm53:
    <<: *vllm-proxy-common
    container_name: proxy-glm53
    environment:
      - NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=all
      - CLOUD_API_URL=https://cloud-api.near.ai
      - CLOUD_API_USAGE_TOKEN=${CLOUD_API_USAGE_TOKEN}
      - COMPOSE_MANAGER_URL=http://compose-manager:8080
      - LOG_FORMAT=json
      - MODEL_NAME=z-ai/glm-5.3-flash
      - OHTTP_ENABLED=true
      - TOKEN=${PROXY_TOKEN}
      - FUSION_ENABLED=${FUSION_ENABLED}
      - FUSION_INTERNAL_BEARER_TOKEN=${FUSION_INTERNAL_BEARER_TOKEN}
      - VLLM_BACKEND_URLS=http://model-sg-glm53-w4afp8-tp2-r1:8000,http://model-sg-glm53-w4afp8-tp2-r2:8000,http://model-sg-glm53-w4afp8-tp2-r3:8000,http://model-sg-glm53-w4afp8-tp2-r4:8000
      # Keep append-only conversations on the replica that already holds their prefix cache
      # (inference-proxy #227); new conversations still balance by least-connections.
      - VLLM_BACKEND_CONVERSATION_AFFINITY=1
      - VLLM_PROXY_MAX_REQUEST_SIZE=104857600
      # Drop pooled upstream connections after 3 s idle. The engines' uvicorn closes an idle
      # keep-alive connection after 5 s (SGLANG_TIMEOUT_KEEP_ALIVE default) while this proxy
      # keeps one for 60 s by default, so a health probe could reuse a connection the engine
      # had already closed: it fails at once and counts toward the 3 misses that mark a
      # replica unhealthy. It applies to every pooled connection of this proxy (engines,

      # Admission-reserve v10 (carried by this image): reserve up to 4096 tokens of each
      # 8192-token prefill chunk for waiting requests, sized on their uncached extend length,
      # bounded so the in-flight long prefill keeps >=25% of the chunk, and refunded when no
      # waiter used it. Pairs with --prefill-decode-interval 1 so admitted requests also decode.
      # Measured (2026-09-12..16 campaign): <=2K prompts p95 TTFT 19.6 s -> 0.6 s; cost ITL p90
      # 30 -> ~240 ms, median unchanged. The patch is inert with the reserve unset (rollback).
      # NEVER set SGLANG_ADMISSION_RESERVE_MIN_WAIT_S (wall-clock gate desyncs the TP ranks; v10
      # raises) or SGLANG_ADMISSION_RESERVE_MIN_ITERS (unmeasured in production).
      - SGLANG_CHUNKED_PREFILL_ADMISSION_RESERVE=4096
      - SGLANG_ADMISSION_RESERVE_MAX_FRACTION=0.75
      - SGLANG_ENABLE_STRICT_MEM_CHECK_DURING_IDLE=1
      # v7 fleet: HiCache is OFF (no --enable-hierarchical-cache in the argv), so the HiCache variables below are
      # unread, exactly as gpu03 r3 runs. They stay so re-enabling is an argv-only change.
      # HiCache host tier: a fixed 325 GiB per replica across its two TP ranks, 1,300 GiB for
      # the four replicas (the lab arm's DRAM total per 8 GPUs; ~5.87M tokens per replica). A
      # percentage would resolve against MemAvailable at each start, so the replicas started
      # later would get less; startup fails if it exceeds available RAM minus 10 GiB.
      - SGLANG_HICACHE_RAM_BUDGET=${GLM53_HICACHE_RAM_BUDGET:-325GiB}
      # CUDA-owned host memory (cudaMallocHost). Must stay 1 on TEE hosts: 0 selects
      # cudaHostRegister, which fails with CUDA error 801 under HCC/PPCIe.
      - SGLANG_HICACHE_CUDA_HOST_MEMORY=${GLM53_HICACHE_CUDA_HOST_MEMORY:-1}
      - SGLANG_HICACHE_POOLED_TRANSFERS=1
      - SGLANG_HICACHE_STAGING_PAGES=64
      # DSA indexer query split. Each TP rank scores 1/TP of a prefill chunk's rows instead of
      # all of them, so the fp32 logits buffer -- sized new_tokens x total_context -- shrinks
      # by TP (halves at TP2). gpu02's long-tier r1 crashed on 2026-09-25 without it:
      # deep_gemm.fp8_mqa_logits asked for 11.96 GiB with 11.88 GiB free at ~392K context
      # (dsa_indexer_kpool.py:919). This is a MITIGATION, not the fix: it divides the buffer
      # by TP and does not bound it. The real fix is calling _should_chunk_mqa_logits
      # (defined, unused, at dsa_indexer_kpool.py:862) and chunking against free memory.
      - SGLANG_DSA_INDEXER_QSPLIT=1
      # Opt-in observability (docker/sglang-glm53-hicache-w4afp8 v6; older images ignore it).
      # TP rank 0 only, off the serving path. The ghost prefix cache hashes each finished
      # request's pages into keyed digests (a 1/16 sample; tokens never leave the engine)
      # on a background thread and exports sglang:ghost_*. Every engine in this CVM shares the
      # key on the in-memory ghost volume and sends its digests to glm53-ghost-aggregator,
      # without ever blocking: if the aggregator is down the sends are dropped and counted.
      # The KV tier metrics export sglang:kv_tier_* (VRAM/DRAM evictions, load-backs, tier sizes).
      - SGLANG_GHOST_CACHE=1
      - SGLANG_GHOST_CACHE_SAMPLE=16
      - SGLANG_GHOST_CACHE_KEY_FILE=/ghost/key
      - SGLANG_GHOST_CACHE_SOCKET=/ghost/aggregator.sock
      - SGLANG_GHOST_CACHE_REPLICA=r4
      - SGLANG_KV_TIER_METRICS=1
      # v7 (opt-in in the image): the preprocess pool (SGLANG_PREPROCESS_WORKERS=0 is the old single-thread path)
      # and the tool-schema caps (0 = off). Profiling is off (no self-profile variables).
      - SGLANG_PREPROCESS_WORKERS=4
      - SGLANG_PREPROCESS_TIMEOUT_S=60
      - SGLANG_PREPROCESS_LOG_SLOW_S=5
      - SGLANG_TOOL_SCHEMA_MAX_DEPTH=32
      - SGLANG_TOOL_SCHEMA_MAX_NODES=25000
    depends_on:
      model-downloader:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          devices:
            - driver: nvidia
              device_ids: ["6","7"]
              capabilities: [gpu]
    labels:
      com.datadoghq.ad.logs: '[{"source":"sglang","service":"sglang","tags":["model:z-ai/glm-5.3-flash","model_path:graphistry/GLM-5.3-Flash-W4AFP8","served_model:z-ai/glm-5.3-flash","precision:int4-weights-fp8-activations-fp8-kv","deployment:glm53-flash-sgl-tp2x4","config_variant:w4afp8-qsplit-hicacheoff-mamba380-fp8kv-memopt086-mr64-c8192-admission-reserve-v10-pdi2-h200-tp2-ep2-eagle-fixed-4-1-5-strict-budget8192-obs-v1-v12-q8","request_logging:disabled","engine_image:da8d4e4b5ec6","env:${ENV}","host:${CVM_HOST}","ip:${HOST_IP}","port:8000","instance:4"]}]'
      nearai.otel.scrape: "true"
      nearai.otel.job: "sglang"
      nearai.otel.service: "sglang"
      nearai.otel.source: "sglang"
      nearai.otel.container_name: "model-sg-glm53-w4afp8-tp2-r4"
      nearai.otel.port: "8000"
      nearai.otel.path: "/metrics"
      nearai.otel.model: "z-ai/glm-5.3-flash"
      nearai.otel.model_path: "graphistry/GLM-5.3-Flash-W4AFP8"
      nearai.otel.served_model: "z-ai/glm-5.3-flash"
      nearai.otel.deployment: "glm53-flash-sgl-tp2x4"
      nearai.otel.config_variant: "w4afp8-qsplit-hicacheoff-mamba380-fp8kv-memopt086-mr64-c8192-admission-reserve-v10-pdi2-h200-tp2-ep2-eagle-fixed-4-1-5-strict-budget8192-obs-v1-v12-q8"
      nearai.otel.thinking_budget_policy: "default8192-public-to-native"
      nearai.otel.request_logging: "disabled"
      nearai.otel.engine_image: "da8d4e4b5ec6"
      nearai.otel.instance: "4"
      nearai.otel.env: "${ENV}"
      nearai.otel.host: "${CVM_HOST}"
      nearai.otel.host_machine: "${CVM_HOST}"

      nearai.otel.ip: "${HOST_IP}"

  # Explicit operator-only semantic check; never starts with a normal stack apply.
  # Runs the candidate's synthetic fixture gate against each replica at concurrency 1.
  # No GPU allocation, host mounts, Docker socket, credentials, or published ports.
  glm53-perception-check:
    image: docker.io/nearaidev/sglang@sha256:e9d29a1cb1cd65284392c4d62d5f2a36669628057e15c60fe93ea40cfe4fc7e7
    container_name: glm53-perception-check
    profiles: ["verification"]
    runtime: runc
    user: "65534:65534"
    read_only: true
    cap_drop: [ALL]
    security_opt: ["no-new-privileges:true"]
    restart: "no"
    mem_limit: 512m
    cpus: 1
    environment:
      - NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=void
      - PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
    entrypoint: ["/usr/bin/python3", "-u", "-c"]
    command:
      - |
        import json, runpy, shutil, sys, urllib.request
        print(json.dumps({"event": "disk", "free_bytes": shutil.disk_usage("/").free}), flush=True)
        failed = False
        for replica in (1, 2, 3, 4):
            base = f"http://model-sg-glm53-w4afp8-tp2-r{replica}:8000"
            print(json.dumps({"event": "replica", "replica": replica}), flush=True)
            for path in ("/health", "/v1/models"):
                with urllib.request.urlopen(base + path, timeout=30) as response:
                    assert response.status == 200
                    if path == "/v1/models":
                        assert "z-ai/glm-5.3-flash" in [row["id"] for row in json.load(response)["data"]]
            sys.argv = ["perception", "--base-url", base, "--size", "512", "--concurrency", "1", "--timeout", "300"]
            try:
                runpy.run_path("/sgl-workspace/sglang/test/manual/test_glm5_next_perception.py", run_name="__main__")
            except SystemExit as result:
                failed = failed or bool(result.code)
        print(json.dumps({"event": "qualification_finished", "ok": not failed}), flush=True)
        raise SystemExit(1 if failed else 0)
    logging: *logging-conf
    labels:
      com.datadoghq.ad.logs: '[{"source":"glm53-perception-check","service":"glm53-perception-check","tags":["model:z-ai/glm-5.3-flash","deployment:glm53-flash-sgl-tp2x4","env:${ENV}","host:${CVM_HOST}","ip:${HOST_IP}"]}]'

  # Explicit operator-only TLS access to each replica for paired qualification.
  # Never registered with the customer router; no model/proxy dependencies.
  glm53-soak-relay:
    image: nginx@sha256:1d13701a5f9f3fb01aaa88cef2344d65b6b5bf6b7d9fa4cf0dca557a8d7702ba
    container_name: glm53-soak-relay
    profiles: ["verification"]
    runtime: runc
    cap_drop: [ALL]
    cap_add: [CHOWN, SETUID, SETGID]
    security_opt: ["no-new-privileges:true"]
    restart: "no"
    mem_limit: 256m
    cpus: 1
    stop_grace_period: 5m
    ports:
      - "8008:8008"
      - "8009:8009"
      - "8010:8010"
      - "8011:8011"
    volumes:
      - certs:/etc/letsencrypt:ro
    tmpfs:
      - /var/cache/nginx:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=64m
      - /var/run:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=4m
    entrypoint: ["nginx", "-g", "daemon off;"]
    configs:
      - source: glm53_soak_nginx_conf
        target: /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
        mode: 0600
    logging: *logging-conf
    labels:
      com.datadoghq.ad.logs: '[{"source":"nginx","service":"nginx","tags":["model:z-ai/glm-5.3-flash","deployment:glm53-flash-sgl-tp2x4","env:${ENV}","host:${CVM_HOST}","ip:${HOST_IP}"]}]'

  # --- Ghost prefix cache aggregator: one per CVM, CPU only ---
  # All four engines in this CVM send their sampled page digests (keyed hashes, never tokens)
  # to /ghost/aggregator.sock on the in-memory ghost volume. This process keeps one LRU across
  # them and exports sglang:ghost_pool_* on :9464: per replica, the reuse one pooled cache
  # would have served and the reuse seen only on another replica. It runs the engines' image so
  # both move together. Serving never depends on it: the engines do not wait for it, and an
  # image without ghost-prefix-cache.diff makes only this container exit and restart.
  glm53-ghost-aggregator:
    image: docker.io/nearaidev/sglang@sha256:fa730e6e62b2ae8058114ce540487ade33ab93bc42b1179ae78edc92bd563fc5
    container_name: glm53-ghost-aggregator
    runtime: runc
    init: true
    cap_drop: [ALL]
    security_opt: ["no-new-privileges:true"]
    mem_limit: 3g
    cpus: 1
    environment:
      - NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=void
      - PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
    entrypoint: ["python3", "-m", "sglang.srt.observability.ghost_aggregator"]
    command: ["--socket", "/ghost/aggregator.sock", "--port", "9464", "--sample", "16", "--model-name", "z-ai/glm-5.3-flash"]
    volumes:
      - ghost:/ghost
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging: *logging-conf
    labels:
      com.datadoghq.ad.logs: '[{"source":"sglang-ghost-aggregator","service":"sglang-ghost-aggregator","tags":["model:z-ai/glm-5.3-flash","served_model:z-ai/glm-5.3-flash","deployment:glm53-flash-sgl-tp2x4","env:${ENV}","host:${CVM_HOST}","ip:${HOST_IP}"]}]'
      nearai.otel.scrape: "true"
      nearai.otel.job: "ghost-aggregator"
      nearai.otel.service: "sglang-ghost-aggregator"
      nearai.otel.source: "sglang-ghost-aggregator"
      nearai.otel.container_name: "glm53-ghost-aggregator"
      nearai.otel.port: "9464"
      nearai.otel.path: "/metrics"
      nearai.otel.model: "z-ai/glm-5.3-flash"
      nearai.otel.served_model: "z-ai/glm-5.3-flash"
      nearai.otel.deployment: "glm53-flash-sgl-tp2x4"
      nearai.otel.env: "${ENV}"
      nearai.otel.host: "${CVM_HOST}"
      nearai.otel.host_machine: "${CVM_HOST}"
      nearai.otel.cvm_name: "${CVM_NAME}"
      nearai.otel.ip: "${HOST_IP}"

  # --- Full-host GPU telemetry ---

  dcgm-glm53:
    <<: *dcgm-common
    container_name: dcgm-glm53
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          devices:
            - driver: nvidia
              device_ids: ["0","1","2","3","4","5","6","7"]
              capabilities: [gpu]
    labels:
      com.datadoghq.ad.logs: '[{"source":"dcgm-exporter","service":"dcgm-exporter","tags":["model:z-ai/glm-5.3-flash","model_path:graphistry/GLM-5.3-Flash-W4AFP8","served_model:z-ai/glm-5.3-flash","deployment:glm53-flash-sgl-tp2x4","env:${ENV}","host:${CVM_HOST}","ip:${HOST_IP}"]}]'
      nearai.otel.scrape: "true"
      nearai.otel.job: "dcgm"
      nearai.otel.service: "dcgm-exporter"
      nearai.otel.source: "dcgm-exporter"
      nearai.otel.container_name: "dcgm-glm53"
      nearai.otel.port: "9400"
      nearai.otel.path: "/metrics"
      nearai.otel.model: "z-ai/glm-5.3-flash"
      nearai.otel.model_path: "graphistry/GLM-5.3-Flash-W4AFP8"
      nearai.otel.served_model: "z-ai/glm-5.3-flash"
      nearai.otel.deployment: "glm53-flash-sgl-tp2x4"
      nearai.otel.env: "${ENV}"
      nearai.otel.host: "${CVM_HOST}"
      nearai.otel.host_machine: "${CVM_HOST}"
      nearai.otel.cvm_name: "${CVM_NAME}"
      nearai.otel.ip: "${HOST_IP}"

  otelcol-contrib:
    image: otel/opentelemetry-collector-contrib@sha256:85ac41c2db88d0df9bd6145e608a3cb023f5d8443868adbfbbf66efb51087917
    container_name: otelcol-contrib
    command: ["--config=/etc/otelcol-contrib/config.yaml"]
    user: "0:0"
    mem_limit: "768m"
    environment:
      - MONITORING_INGEST_TOKEN=${MONITORING_INGEST_TOKEN:-}
      - CVM_NAME=${CVM_NAME:-unknown}
      - CVM_HOST=${CVM_HOST:-unknown}
      - DD_HOSTNAME=${DD_HOSTNAME:-unknown}
      - ENV=${ENV:-unknown}
      - HOST_IP=${HOST_IP:-unknown}
    expose:
      - "4317"
      - "4318"
    volumes:
      - /var/lib/docker/containers:/var/lib/docker/containers:ro
      - otelcol_app_storage:/var/lib/otelcol-contrib
    configs:
      - source: otelcol_app_config
        target: /etc/otelcol-contrib/config.yaml
        mode: 0444
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: "local"
      options:
        max-size: "20m"
        max-file: "3"
    labels:
      com.datadoghq.ad.logs: '[{"source":"otelcol-contrib","service":"otelcol-contrib","tags":["deployment:glm53-flash-sgl-tp2x4","env:${ENV}","host:${CVM_HOST}","ip:${HOST_IP}"]}]'

configs:
  glm53_soak_nginx_conf:
    content: |
      user nginx;
      worker_processes 1;
      pid /var/run/nginx.pid;
      error_log /dev/null;
      events { worker_connections 64; }
      http {
        # No request/response logging or disk buffering of qualification traffic.
        access_log off;
        client_max_body_size 100m;
        client_body_timeout 3600s;
        send_timeout 3600s;
        resolver 127.0.0.11 valid=5s ipv6=off;
        map_hash_bucket_size 256;
        map $$http_authorization $$soak_authorized {
          default 0;
          "Bearer ${PROXY_TOKEN:?PROXY_TOKEN required for authenticated soak access}" 1;
        }
        ssl_certificate /etc/letsencrypt/live/completions.near.ai/fullchain.pem;
        ssl_certificate_key /etc/letsencrypt/live/completions.near.ai/privkey.pem;
        ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_request_buffering off;
        proxy_buffering off;
        proxy_max_temp_file_size 0;
        proxy_connect_timeout 10s;
        proxy_read_timeout 3600s;
        proxy_send_timeout 3600s;
        proxy_set_header Authorization "";
        proxy_set_header Connection "";
        proxy_next_upstream off;
        server {
          listen 8008 ssl;
          server_name _;
          if ($$soak_authorized = 0) { return 401; }
          set $$backend http://model-sg-glm53-w4afp8-tp2-r1:8000;
          location ~ ^/(health|metrics|v1/models|v1/chat/completions|v1/completions|v1/responses)$$ {
            limit_except GET POST { deny all; }
            proxy_pass $$backend$$request_uri;
          }
          location / { return 404; }
        }
        server {
          listen 8009 ssl;
          server_name _;
          if ($$soak_authorized = 0) { return 401; }
          set $$backend http://model-sg-glm53-w4afp8-tp2-r2:8000;
          location ~ ^/(health|metrics|v1/models|v1/chat/completions|v1/completions|v1/responses)$$ {
            limit_except GET POST { deny all; }
            proxy_pass $$backend$$request_uri;
          }
          location / { return 404; }
        }
        server {
          listen 8010 ssl;
          server_name _;
          if ($$soak_authorized = 0) { return 401; }
          set $$backend http://model-sg-glm53-w4afp8-tp2-r3:8000;
          location ~ ^/(health|metrics|v1/models|v1/chat/completions|v1/completions|v1/responses)$$ {
            limit_except GET POST { deny all; }
            proxy_pass $$backend$$request_uri;
          }
          location / { return 404; }
        }
        server {
          listen 8011 ssl;
          server_name _;
          if ($$soak_authorized = 0) { return 401; }
          set $$backend http://model-sg-glm53-w4afp8-tp2-r4:8000;
          location ~ ^/(health|metrics|v1/models|v1/chat/completions|v1/completions|v1/responses)$$ {
            limit_except GET POST { deny all; }
            proxy_pass $$backend$$request_uri;
          }
          location / { return 404; }
        }
      }

  dcgm_h200_metrics:
    content: |
      # NEAR AI H200 operational collector for DCGM 4.6.0 / exporter 4.8.3.
      # Format: DCGM field, Prometheus type, help message.

      # Clocks, temperature, power and cumulative GPU-board energy.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_SM_CLOCK, gauge, SM clock frequency in MHz.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_MEM_CLOCK, gauge, Memory clock frequency in MHz.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_MEMORY_TEMP, gauge, Memory temperature in C.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP, gauge, GPU temperature in C.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_USAGE, gauge, GPU board power draw in W.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_TOTAL_ENERGY_CONSUMPTION, counter, GPU board energy consumed since boot in mJ.

      # Utilization, framebuffer and PCIe.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL, gauge, GPU utilization in percent.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_MEM_COPY_UTIL, gauge, Memory copy utilization in percent.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_FREE, gauge, Framebuffer memory free in MiB.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED, gauge, Framebuffer memory used in MiB.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_RESERVED, gauge, Framebuffer memory reserved in MiB.
      DCGM_FI_PROF_PCIE_TX_BYTES, gauge, PCIe transmit throughput in bytes per second.
      DCGM_FI_PROF_PCIE_RX_BYTES, gauge, PCIe receive throughput in bytes per second.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_PCIE_REPLAY_COUNTER, counter, Total PCIe replay events.

      # Raw and exporter-owned incident signals. Windowed counts provide a
      # stable zero series; cumulative totals preserve observed event labels.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_XID_ERRORS, gauge, Last XID error encountered.
      DCGM_EXP_XID_ERRORS_COUNT, gauge, XID records observed in the configured window.
      DCGM_EXP_XID_ERRORS_TOTAL, counter, XID records observed since exporter start.
      DCGM_EXP_CLOCK_EVENTS_COUNT, gauge, Clock events observed in the configured window.
      DCGM_EXP_CLOCK_EVENTS_TOTAL, counter, Clock event transitions observed since exporter start.
      DCGM_EXP_GPU_HEALTH_STATUS, gauge, Current DCGM GPU health status by health watch.
      DCGM_EXP_P2P_STATUS, gauge, Current NVLink P2P status for each ordered GPU pair.

      # Throttling and reliability constraints.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_VIOLATION, counter, Throttling duration due to power constraints in ns.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_THERMAL_VIOLATION, counter, Throttling duration due to thermal constraints in ns.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_SYNC_BOOST_VIOLATION, counter, Throttling duration due to sync boost constraints in ns.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_BOARD_LIMIT_VIOLATION, counter, Throttling duration due to board constraints in ns.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_LOW_UTIL_VIOLATION, counter, Throttling duration due to low utilization in ns.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_RELIABILITY_VIOLATION, counter, Throttling duration due to reliability constraints in ns.

      # ECC, retired pages and row remapping.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_ECC_SBE_VOL_TOTAL, counter, Total volatile single-bit ECC errors.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_ECC_DBE_VOL_TOTAL, counter, Total volatile double-bit ECC errors.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_ECC_SBE_AGG_TOTAL, counter, Total aggregate single-bit ECC errors.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_ECC_DBE_AGG_TOTAL, counter, Total aggregate double-bit ECC errors.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_RETIRED_SBE, counter, Total pages retired due to single-bit errors.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_RETIRED_DBE, counter, Total pages retired due to double-bit errors.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_RETIRED_PENDING, counter, Pages pending retirement.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_UNCORRECTABLE_REMAPPED_ROWS, counter, Total uncorrectable remapped rows.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_CORRECTABLE_REMAPPED_ROWS, counter, Total correctable remapped rows.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_ROW_REMAP_FAILURE, gauge, Whether row remapping has failed.

      # NVLink traffic and integrity.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_NVLINK_BANDWIDTH_TOTAL, gauge, Aggregate NVLink traffic rate across all lanes.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_NVLINK_CRC_FLIT_ERROR_COUNT_TOTAL, counter, Total NVLink flow-control CRC errors.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_NVLINK_CRC_DATA_ERROR_COUNT_TOTAL, counter, Total NVLink data CRC errors.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_NVLINK_REPLAY_ERROR_COUNT_TOTAL, counter, Total NVLink replay errors.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_NVLINK_RECOVERY_ERROR_COUNT_TOTAL, counter, Total NVLink recovery errors.

      # Workload profiling. Unsupported fields are skipped by DCGM and must be
      # represented as unsupported in Grafana rather than coerced to zero.
      DCGM_FI_PROF_GR_ENGINE_ACTIVE, gauge, Ratio of time the graphics engine is active.
      DCGM_FI_PROF_PIPE_TENSOR_ACTIVE, gauge, Ratio of cycles the tensor pipe is active.
      DCGM_FI_PROF_DRAM_ACTIVE, gauge, Ratio of time the device memory interface is active.

      # Stable software identity labels attached to emitted GPU metrics.
      DCGM_FI_DRIVER_VERSION, label, NVIDIA driver version.
      DCGM_FI_NVML_VERSION, label, NVML version.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_BRAND, label, GPU product brand.

  registrar_script:
    content: |
      #!/bin/sh
      PROXY_URL="https://completions.near.ai"
      TOKEN="$${MODEL_PROXY_TOKEN}"
      INFERENCE_TOKEN="$${PROXY_TOKEN}"

      if [ -z "$$TOKEN" ] || [ -z "$$INFERENCE_TOKEN" ]; then
        echo "ERROR: MODEL_PROXY_TOKEN and PROXY_TOKEN are required for model-proxy registration"
        exit 1
      fi

      ENDPOINT="$${HOST_IP}:$${HTTP_PORT}"
      REGISTERED=false
      FAILURE_COUNT=0
      MAX_RETRIES=3

      register_endpoint() {
        echo "Registering endpoint $$1 with routing port $$2"
        curl -fsS --max-time 10 -X POST "$$PROXY_URL/register/endpoint" \
          -H "Authorization: Bearer $$TOKEN" \
          -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
          -d "{\"endpoint\":\"$$1\",\"routing_port\":$$2}"
      }

      unregister_endpoint() {
        echo "Unregistering endpoint $$1"
        curl -fsS --max-time 10 -X POST "$$PROXY_URL/unregister/endpoint" \
          -H "Authorization: Bearer $$TOKEN" \
          -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
          -d "{\"endpoint\":\"$$1\"}"
      }

      register_model() {
        curl -fsS --max-time 10 -X POST "$$PROXY_URL/register/model" \
          -H "Authorization: Bearer $$TOKEN" \
          -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
          -d "{\"model\":\"$$1\",\"domain\":\"$$2\"}"
      }

      cleanup() {
        echo "SIGTERM received, unregistering $$ENDPOINT"
        unregister_endpoint "$$ENDPOINT"
        REGISTERED=false
        exit 0
      }
      trap cleanup TERM INT

      mark_registered() {
        if ! register_endpoint "$$ENDPOINT" "$${TLS_PORT}"; then
          echo "[GLM-5.3-Flash-SGL-TP4] Endpoint registration failed; retrying on the next loop"
          return 1
        fi
        if ! register_model "z-ai/glm-5.3-flash" "glm-5-3-flash.completions.near.ai"; then
          echo "[GLM-5.3-Flash-SGL-TP4] Model registration failed; retrying on the next loop"
          return 1
        fi
        if [ "$$REGISTERED" = false ]; then
          echo "[GLM-5.3-Flash-SGL-TP4] Registered z-ai/glm-5.3-flash (4x TP2/EP2) at $$ENDPOINT"
        fi
        REGISTERED=true
      }

      # The previous mixed stack published its retired co-resident engine on
      # port 8001. Remove only this host-local endpoint; the global model-domain
      # mapping must remain while other hosts may still serve that model.
      unregister_endpoint "$${HOST_IP}:8001" || \
        echo "[GLM-5.3-Flash-SGL-TP4] WARN: legacy endpoint cleanup failed; continuing"

      # Probe the host-published nginx port. The inference-proxy health-manages
      # both internal replicas, so registration represents the pooled endpoint.
      check_inference() {
        status=$$(curl -sS --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 45 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" \
          -X POST "http://$${HOST_IP}:$${HTTP_PORT}/v1/chat/completions" \
          -H "Authorization: Bearer $$INFERENCE_TOKEN" \
          -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
          -d '{"model":"z-ai/glm-5.3-flash","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}],"max_tokens":1}')
        curl_status=$$?

        if [ "$$curl_status" -ne 0 ]; then
          case "$$curl_status" in
            52|56)
              echo "[GLM-5.3-Flash-SGL-TP4] Health probe hit connection-level backpressure (curl $$curl_status); treating as alive but saturated"
              return 2
              ;;
            28)
              # Probe timeout is NOT proof of death: a 1-token completion
              # queues behind long-context prefills and legitimately exceeds
              # 45s under prod load, with no 503/backpressure signal. Observed
              # 2026-09-17 on the GLM-5.3 long-context tier: with one replica
              # warming, the other's 250K-token prefills pushed a 1-token probe
              # past 45 s three times and the host unregistered itself while
              # serving fine. Disambiguate with a fast /v1/models probe - it
              # answers from the HTTP layer even at full queue depth, so 2xx
              # here means alive-but-saturated. Genuinely dead backends still
              # fail this and unregister; model-proxy's own /healthz checker +
              # breaker (PR#42) covers them within seconds regardless.
              if curl -sf --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 10 \
                -H "Authorization: Bearer $$INFERENCE_TOKEN" \
                "http://$${HOST_IP}:$${HTTP_PORT}/v1/models" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
                echo "[GLM-5.3-Flash-SGL-TP4] Health probe timed out but /v1/models is live; treating as alive but saturated"
                return 2
              fi
              echo "[GLM-5.3-Flash-SGL-TP4] Health probe timed out and /v1/models is unreachable"
              return 1
              ;;
          esac
          echo "[GLM-5.3-Flash-SGL-TP4] Health probe curl failed with status $$curl_status"
          return 1
        fi

        case "$$status" in
          2*)
            return 0
            ;;
          503)
            echo "[GLM-5.3-Flash-SGL-TP4] Backend returned 503; treating as alive but saturated"
            return 2
            ;;
          *)
            echo "[GLM-5.3-Flash-SGL-TP4] Backend returned HTTP $$status"
            return 1
            ;;
        esac
      }

      READY_URL="http://$${HOST_IP}:$${HTTP_PORT}/v1/models"
      echo "Waiting for model to be ready (probing $$READY_URL)..."
      ready_attempts=0
      until curl --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 10 -sf \
        -H "Authorization: Bearer $$INFERENCE_TOKEN" \
        "$$READY_URL" > /dev/null 2>&1; do
        ready_attempts=$$((ready_attempts + 1))
        if [ "$$ready_attempts" -ge 30 ]; then
          echo "WARN: model not reachable at $$READY_URL after $$ready_attempts attempts (~20m); entering registration loop anyway"
          break
        fi
        echo "Model not ready yet (attempt $$ready_attempts/30), retrying in 30s..."
        sleep 30
      done
      echo "Model ready, starting registration loop"

      while true; do
        date +%s > /tmp/registrar_alive
        check_inference
        health_status=$$?
        case "$$health_status" in
          0)
            if mark_registered; then
              FAILURE_COUNT=0
            else
              FAILURE_COUNT=$$((FAILURE_COUNT + 1))
            fi
            ;;
          2)
            echo "[GLM-5.3-Flash-SGL-TP4] Keeping $$ENDPOINT registered while backend is saturated"
            if mark_registered; then
              FAILURE_COUNT=0
            else
              FAILURE_COUNT=$$((FAILURE_COUNT + 1))
            fi
            ;;
          *)
            FAILURE_COUNT=$$((FAILURE_COUNT + 1))
            echo "[GLM-5.3-Flash-SGL-TP4] Health check failed ($$FAILURE_COUNT/$$MAX_RETRIES)"
            if [ "$$REGISTERED" = true ] && [ "$$FAILURE_COUNT" -ge "$$MAX_RETRIES" ]; then
              echo "[GLM-5.3-Flash-SGL-TP4] Retry limit reached, unregistering $$ENDPOINT"
              unregister_endpoint "$$ENDPOINT"
              REGISTERED=false
              echo "[GLM-5.3-Flash-SGL-TP4] Exiting to refresh DNS (container will auto-restart)"
              exit 1
            fi
            ;;
        esac
        sleep 60
      done
  nginx_conf:
    content: |
      log_format json_combined escape=json
        '{'  '"time":"$$time_iso8601"'
        ',"request_id":"$$http_x_request_id"'
        ',"org_id":"$$http_x_org_id"'
        ',"workspace_id":"$$http_x_workspace_id"'
        ',"http_host":"$$host"'
        ',"method":"$$request_method"'
        ',"uri":"$$uri"'
        ',"status":$$status'
        ',"request_length":$$request_length'
        ',"bytes_sent":$$bytes_sent'
        ',"request_time":$$request_time'
        ',"upstream_addr":"$$upstream_addr"'
        '}';

      access_log /var/log/nginx/access.log json_combined;

      proxy_http_version 1.1;
      proxy_set_header Host $$host;
      proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $$remote_addr;
      proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $$proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
      proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $$scheme;
      proxy_set_header Connection '';
      proxy_buffering off;
      proxy_cache off;
      proxy_read_timeout 3600s;
      client_max_body_size 100m;
      client_body_buffer_size 1m;

      # Resolve proxy-glm53 through Docker's embedded DNS at request time
      # (proxy_pass with a variable) instead of once at startup, so a recreated
      # proxy container with a new IP is picked up immediately rather than at
      # the next 6-hourly reload. Same pattern as the soak relay above.
      resolver 127.0.0.11 valid=5s ipv6=off;

      # :8000 - GLM-5.3-Flash
      server {
        listen 8000;
        location / {
          set $$proxy_glm53 http://proxy-glm53:8000;
          proxy_pass $$proxy_glm53;
        }
      }
      ssl_certificate /etc/letsencrypt/live/completions.near.ai/fullchain.pem;
      ssl_certificate_key /etc/letsencrypt/live/completions.near.ai/privkey.pem;
      ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;

      server {
        listen 443 ssl http2;
        server_name glm-5-3-flash.completions.near.ai
                    glm-5-3-flash.completions-stg.near.ai
                    ~^glm-5-3-flash-i\d+\.completions(-stg)?\.near\.ai$$;
        # Keep H2 connections from cloud-api alive across long idle gaps so the
        # bucket-pinned TCP connection survives between chats. Without this,
        # nginx defaults (75s idle, 1000 req/conn) close the connection and the
        # next request opens a new TCP via model-proxy's L4 LB → may land on a
        # different backend → signature 404. Pairs with cloud-api H2 keepalive
        # PINGs (http2_keep_alive_while_idle).
        keepalive_timeout 1h;
        keepalive_requests 1000000;
        location ^~ /metrics { return 404; }
        location ^~ /v1/metrics { return 404; }
        location / {
          set $$proxy_glm53 http://proxy-glm53:8000;
          proxy_pass $$proxy_glm53;
        }

# GLM-5.3-Flash on four independent H200 TP2/EP2 replicas. Each replica stays
# within one NVLink GPU pair; one inference-proxy uses its native
# least-connections backend pool for health-aware balancing and failover.
#
# The engine is published by the repository's GitHub Actions workflow and pinned here by
# its signed immutable registry digest. Its source is pinned to
# PierreLeGuen/sglang-upstream commit fc91d24, derived from official SGLang main plus
# the official GLM-5.3 branch. It contains upstream disconnect cleanup (#35255), the
# final-prefill abort fix (#34153), the strict thinking-budget adapter, and two narrow
# DSA import-cycle fixes. All four replicas pin the published split-capable
# docker/sglang-glm53-hicache-w4afp8 derivative the long tier runs (glm53-hicache-w4afp8-v6):
# the HCC-safe HiCache image (CUDA-owned host memory, carrying the opt-in chunked-prefill
# admission-reserve v10 patch, nearai/inference-optimizer@fb94472) plus the W4AFP8
# loader fix and the unconditional chunked-prefill pool clamp. The reserve is enabled
# below with SGLANG_CHUNKED_PREFILL_ADMISSION_RESERVE=4096,
# SGLANG_ADMISSION_RESERVE_MAX_FRACTION=0.75 and --prefill-decode-interval 1. The
# official CUDA 13 SGLang image is the pinned build base. The serving envelope is
# intentionally conservative: BF16 KV, 0.80 static memory, 32 running requests (an
# effective 32 per TP2 replica with 165 BF16 mamba state slots, see the file header), a
# bounded 8-request queue, 8192-token prefill chunks with --max-prefill-tokens 32768,
# decode graphs capped at batch 32, TileLang DSA, the CUTLASS W4A8 MoE path (hence no
# --moe-runner-backend and no FP8 --revision), and adaptive EAGLE 5/1/6. This retains
# the full 1,048,576-token model context.
# Priority scheduling (--enable-priority-scheduling, --disable-priority-preemption)
# relies on the pinned inference-proxy below (build 2834196, nearai/inference-proxy#241)
# overwriting the `priority` field of every forwarded request, so no client-chosen
# or missing priority ever reaches the scheduler. --default-priority-value is
# deliberately absent for the same reason. scripts/validate_glm53_prod_config.rb
# refuses the priority switches unless proxy-glm53 pins a priority-normalizing build.
#
# A small fail-closed adapter patch maps the public thinking_token_budget field
# to SGLang strict-thinking's custom_params.thinking_budget. Omitted values
# default to 8192; explicit null remains an opt-out; an explicit native
# custom_params.thinking_budget wins. Request/response payload logging is off.
#
# The vLLM GLM-5.3-Flash path is not used: its Hopper NVFP4/MLA path produced
# non-finite logits and repetitive output. This pack also retires the previous
# co-resident DeepSeek arm so both four-GPU islands serve GLM-5.3-Flash.

    nofile:

x-vllm-proxy-common: &vllm-proxy-common

x-sg-glm53-flash-common: &sg-glm53-flash-common

  image: docker.io/nearaidev/sglang@sha256:da8d4e4b5ec667499b58a21e56050aae9bcfc4df9669b3ac27e2e20af033d681
  command: >
      sglang serve
      --model-path /root/.cache/huggingface/hub/models--graphistry--GLM-5.3-Flash-W4AFP8/snapshots/99f1fa70408c52b007d4fd69e02e5a522422e755

      --tp-size 2
      --ep-size 2
      --mem-fraction-static 0.80
      --max-running-requests 32
      --max-queued-requests 8
      --enable-priority-scheduling
      --disable-priority-preemption
      --chunked-prefill-size 8192
      --max-prefill-tokens 32768
      --prefill-decode-interval 1
      --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 32
      --dsa-prefill-backend tilelang
      --dsa-decode-backend tilelang
      --kv-cache-dtype bfloat16
      --speculative-algorithm EAGLE
      --speculative-num-steps 5
      --speculative-eagle-topk 1
      --speculative-num-draft-tokens 6
      --speculative-adaptive
      --reasoning-parser glm45

      --enable-cache-report

      --hicache-io-backend direct
      --hicache-mem-layout page_first_direct
      --max-mamba-cache-size 165
      --mamba-ssm-dtype bfloat16
  volumes:
    - kernel_cache:/root/.cache
    - huggingface_cache:/root/.cache/huggingface
    - ghost:/ghost
  environment:
    - HF_TOKEN=${HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN}
    # Local snapshot path; nothing is fetched at engine start.
    - HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
    - TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
    - HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1
    - DO_NOT_TRACK=1
    - NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES=compute,utility
    - OPENBLAS_L2_SIZE=2097152
    - NCCL_DEBUG=WARN
    - PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
    - TORCHINDUCTOR_CACHE_DIR=/root/.cache/torchinductor
    - TRITON_CACHE_DIR=/root/.cache/triton
    # Persist tilelang's DSA kernel JIT cache: it defaults to /root/.tilelang, outside
    # the kernel_cache volume, so every restart re-paid ~22-24 compiles at 8-9 s each
    # with the whole engine frozen (2026-09-12..16 capacity campaign).
    - TILELANG_CACHE_DIR=/root/.cache/tilelang
    # /health must not run a generation: at this pin health_generate submits a real
    # 1-token request that queues behind any in-flight long prefill, so the CVM
    # proxy's 3 s probe times out, the replica flaps unhealthy, and the conversation
    # affinity pin is skipped (full re-prefill on the other replica). nearai/infra#234.
    - SGLANG_ENABLE_HEALTH_ENDPOINT_GENERATION=0
    # Admission-reserve v10 (carried by this image): reserve up to 4096 tokens of each
    # 8192-token prefill chunk for waiting requests, sized on their uncached extend length,
    # bounded so the in-flight long prefill keeps >=25% of the chunk, and refunded when no
    # waiter used it. Pairs with --prefill-decode-interval 1 so admitted requests also decode.
    # Measured (2026-09-12..16 campaign): <=2K prompts p95 TTFT 19.6 s -> 0.6 s; cost ITL p90
    # 30 -> ~240 ms, median unchanged. The patch is inert with the reserve unset (rollback).
    # NEVER set SGLANG_ADMISSION_RESERVE_MIN_WAIT_S (wall-clock gate desyncs the TP ranks; v10
    # raises) or SGLANG_ADMISSION_RESERVE_MIN_ITERS (unmeasured in production).
    - SGLANG_CHUNKED_PREFILL_ADMISSION_RESERVE=4096
    - SGLANG_ADMISSION_RESERVE_MAX_FRACTION=0.75
    - SGLANG_ENABLE_STRICT_MEM_CHECK_DURING_IDLE=1
    # v7 fleet: HiCache is OFF (no --enable-hierarchical-cache in the argv), so the HiCache variables below are
    # unread, exactly as gpu03 r3 runs. They stay so re-enabling is an argv-only change.
    # HiCache host tier: a fixed 325 GiB per replica across its two TP ranks, 1,300 GiB for
    # the four replicas (the lab arm's DRAM total per 8 GPUs; ~5.87M tokens per replica). A
    # percentage would resolve against MemAvailable at each start, so the replicas started
    # later would get less; startup fails if it exceeds available RAM minus 10 GiB.
    - SGLANG_HICACHE_RAM_BUDGET=${GLM53_HICACHE_RAM_BUDGET:-325GiB}
    # CUDA-owned host memory (cudaMallocHost). Must stay 1 on TEE hosts: 0 selects
    # cudaHostRegister, which fails with CUDA error 801 under HCC/PPCIe.
    - SGLANG_HICACHE_CUDA_HOST_MEMORY=${GLM53_HICACHE_CUDA_HOST_MEMORY:-1}
    - SGLANG_HICACHE_POOLED_TRANSFERS=1
    - SGLANG_HICACHE_STAGING_PAGES=64
    # DSA indexer query split. Each TP rank scores 1/TP of a prefill chunk's rows instead of
    # all of them, so the fp32 logits buffer -- sized new_tokens x total_context -- shrinks
    # by TP (halves at TP2). gpu02's long-tier r1 crashed on 2026-09-25 without it:
    # deep_gemm.fp8_mqa_logits asked for 11.96 GiB with 11.88 GiB free at ~392K context
    # (dsa_indexer_kpool.py:919). This is a MITIGATION, not the fix: it divides the buffer
    # by TP and does not bound it. The real fix is calling _should_chunk_mqa_logits
    # (defined, unused, at dsa_indexer_kpool.py:862) and chunking against free memory.
    - SGLANG_DSA_INDEXER_QSPLIT=1
    # Opt-in observability (docker/sglang-glm53-hicache-w4afp8 v6; older images ignore it).
    # TP rank 0 only, off the serving path. The ghost prefix cache hashes each finished
    # request's pages into keyed digests (a 1/16 sample; tokens never leave the engine)
    # on a background thread and exports sglang:ghost_*. Every engine in this CVM shares the
    # key on the in-memory ghost volume and sends its digests to glm53-ghost-aggregator,
    # without ever blocking: if the aggregator is down the sends are dropped and counted.
    # The KV tier metrics export sglang:kv_tier_* (VRAM/DRAM evictions, load-backs, tier sizes).
    - SGLANG_GHOST_CACHE=1
    - SGLANG_GHOST_CACHE_SAMPLE=16
    - SGLANG_GHOST_CACHE_KEY_FILE=/ghost/key
    - SGLANG_GHOST_CACHE_SOCKET=/ghost/aggregator.sock
    - SGLANG_GHOST_CACHE_REPLICA=r1
    - SGLANG_KV_TIER_METRICS=1
    # v7 (opt-in in the image): the preprocess pool (SGLANG_PREPROCESS_WORKERS=0 is the old single-thread path)
    # and the tool-schema caps (0 = off). Profiling is off (no self-profile variables).
    - SGLANG_PREPROCESS_WORKERS=4
    - SGLANG_PREPROCESS_TIMEOUT_S=60
    - SGLANG_PREPROCESS_LOG_SLOW_S=5
    - SGLANG_TOOL_SCHEMA_MAX_DEPTH=32
    - SGLANG_TOOL_SCHEMA_MAX_NODES=25000
  restart: unless-stopped
  stop_grace_period: 5m
  logging: *logging-conf

  # Inlined copy of the root cleanup-hf-model.yaml service: compose-manager's
  # compose/up fetches only the requested file, so cross-file `extends:` /
  # `include:` must not be used here (they fail at config load).
  hf-cleanup:
    image: alpine:3.20@sha256:d9e853e87e55526f6b2917df91a2115c36dd7c696a35be12163d44e6e2a4b6bc
    container_name: hf-cleanup
    profiles: ["maintenance"]
    restart: "no"
    entrypoint: ["sh", "-c"]
    command:
      - |
        set -eu
        : "$${MODEL_NAME:?MODEL_NAME env var is required (e.g. zai-org/GLM-5-FP8)}"

        echo "=== Disk usage ==="
        df -h /root/.cache 2>/dev/null || df -h /

        echo ""
        echo "=== Cached model weights ==="
        HUB=/root/.cache/huggingface/hub
        if ls "$$HUB"/models--* >/dev/null 2>&1; then
          du -sh "$$HUB"/models--* | sort -rh
        else
          echo "(none)"
        fi
        echo ""
        echo "Total HF cache: $$(du -sh $$HUB 2>/dev/null | cut -f1)"

        echo ""
        echo "=== Cleanup ==="
        SAFE=$$(printf '%s' "$$MODEL_NAME" | sed 's|/|--|g')
        TARGET="$$HUB/models--$$SAFE"
        echo "MODEL_NAME=$$MODEL_NAME"
        echo "TARGET=$$TARGET"
        if [ ! -d "$$TARGET" ]; then
          echo "Not found — nothing to remove."
          exit 0
        fi
        echo "Removing $$(du -sh "$$TARGET" | cut -f1) ..."
        rm -rf "$$TARGET"
        echo "Removed $$TARGET"
        echo "Disk after: $$(df -h /root/.cache 2>/dev/null | tail -1 || df -h / | tail -1)"
    volumes:
      - huggingface_cache:/root/.cache/huggingface
    environment:
      - MODEL_NAME=${MODEL_NAME:-}
    # Verbatim from cleanup-hf-model.yaml (not the file-wide *logging-conf) so the
    # rendered service is unchanged from the previous `extends` result.
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"
        labels: "com.datadoghq.ad.logs"

  nginx:
    image: nginx@sha256:1d13701a5f9f3fb01aaa88cef2344d65b6b5bf6b7d9fa4cf0dca557a8d7702ba
    container_name: nginx
    depends_on:
      - proxy-glm53
    command: /bin/sh -c 'cert=/etc/letsencrypt/live/completions.near.ai/fullchain.pem; last=$$(stat -L -c %Y "$$cert" 2>/dev/null); while :; do sleep 60; cur=$$(stat -L -c %Y "$$cert" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$$cur" ] && [ "$$cur" != "$$last" ]; then last=$$cur; echo "$$cert changed, reloading nginx"; nginx -s reload; fi; done & while :; do sleep 6h; nginx -s reload; done & nginx -g "daemon off;"'
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
      - "8444:443"
    volumes:
      - certs:/etc/letsencrypt:ro
    configs:
      - source: nginx_conf
        target: /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
        mode: 0644
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging: *logging-conf
    labels:
      com.datadoghq.ad.logs: '[{"source":"nginx","service":"nginx","tags":["model:z-ai/glm-5.3-flash","deployment:glm53-flash-sgl-tp2x4","env:${ENV}","host:${CVM_HOST}","ip:${HOST_IP}","port:8000"]}]'

    <<: *vllm-proxy-common

      - CLOUD_API_URL=https://cloud-api.near.ai

      - LOG_FORMAT=json
      - MODEL_NAME=z-ai/glm-5.3-flash
      - OHTTP_ENABLED=true
      - TOKEN=${PROXY_TOKEN}
      - FUSION_ENABLED=${FUSION_ENABLED}
      - FUSION_INTERNAL_BEARER_TOKEN=${FUSION_INTERNAL_BEARER_TOKEN}
      - VLLM_BACKEND_URLS=http://model-sg-glm53-w4afp8-tp2-r1:8000,http://model-sg-glm53-w4afp8-tp2-r2:8000,http://model-sg-glm53-w4afp8-tp2-r3:8000,http://model-sg-glm53-w4afp8-tp2-r4:8000

      # (inference-proxy #227); new conversations still balance by least-connections.

      # had already closed: it fails at once and counts toward the 3 misses that mark a
      # replica unhealthy. It applies to every pooled connection of this proxy (engines,
      # cloud-api, compose-manager); each reconnects after 3 s idle.

      - OPENBLAS_L2_SIZE=2097152
      - NCCL_DEBUG=WARN
      - PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
      - TORCHINDUCTOR_CACHE_DIR=/root/.cache/torchinductor
      - TRITON_CACHE_DIR=/root/.cache/triton
      # Persist tilelang's DSA kernel JIT cache: it defaults to /root/.tilelang, outside
      # the kernel_cache volume, so every restart re-paid ~22-24 compiles at 8-9 s each
      # with the whole engine frozen (2026-09-12..16 capacity campaign).
      - TILELANG_CACHE_DIR=/root/.cache/tilelang
      # /health must not run a generation: at this pin health_generate submits a real
      # 1-token request that queues behind any in-flight long prefill, so the CVM
      # proxy's 3 s probe times out, the replica flaps unhealthy, and the conversation
      # affinity pin is skipped (full re-prefill on the other replica). nearai/infra#234.
      - SGLANG_ENABLE_HEALTH_ENDPOINT_GENERATION=0
      # Admission-reserve v10 (carried by this image): reserve up to 4096 tokens of each
      # 8192-token prefill chunk for waiting requests, sized on their uncached extend length,
      # bounded so the in-flight long prefill keeps >=25% of the chunk, and refunded when no
      # waiter used it. Pairs with --prefill-decode-interval 1 so admitted requests also decode.
      # Measured (2026-09-12..16 campaign): <=2K prompts p95 TTFT 19.6 s -> 0.6 s; cost ITL p90
      # 30 -> ~240 ms, median unchanged. The patch is inert with the reserve unset (rollback).
      # NEVER set SGLANG_ADMISSION_RESERVE_MIN_WAIT_S (wall-clock gate desyncs the TP ranks; v10
      # raises) or SGLANG_ADMISSION_RESERVE_MIN_ITERS (unmeasured in production).
      - SGLANG_CHUNKED_PREFILL_ADMISSION_RESERVE=4096
      - SGLANG_ADMISSION_RESERVE_MAX_FRACTION=0.75
      - SGLANG_ENABLE_STRICT_MEM_CHECK_DURING_IDLE=1
      # v7 fleet: HiCache is OFF (no --enable-hierarchical-cache in the argv), so the HiCache variables below are
      # unread, exactly as gpu03 r3 runs. They stay so re-enabling is an argv-only change.
      # HiCache host tier: a fixed 325 GiB per replica across its two TP ranks, 1,300 GiB for
      # the four replicas (the lab arm's DRAM total per 8 GPUs; ~5.87M tokens per replica). A
      # percentage would resolve against MemAvailable at each start, so the replicas started
      # later would get less; startup fails if it exceeds available RAM minus 10 GiB.
      - SGLANG_HICACHE_RAM_BUDGET=${GLM53_HICACHE_RAM_BUDGET:-325GiB}
      # CUDA-owned host memory (cudaMallocHost). Must stay 1 on TEE hosts: 0 selects
      # cudaHostRegister, which fails with CUDA error 801 under HCC/PPCIe.
      - SGLANG_HICACHE_CUDA_HOST_MEMORY=${GLM53_HICACHE_CUDA_HOST_MEMORY:-1}
      - SGLANG_HICACHE_POOLED_TRANSFERS=1
      - SGLANG_HICACHE_STAGING_PAGES=64
      # DSA indexer query split. Each TP rank scores 1/TP of a prefill chunk's rows instead of
      # all of them, so the fp32 logits buffer -- sized new_tokens x total_context -- shrinks
      # by TP (halves at TP2). gpu02's long-tier r1 crashed on 2026-09-25 without it:
      # deep_gemm.fp8_mqa_logits asked for 11.96 GiB with 11.88 GiB free at ~392K context
      # (dsa_indexer_kpool.py:919). This is a MITIGATION, not the fix: it divides the buffer
      # by TP and does not bound it. The real fix is calling _should_chunk_mqa_logits
      # (defined, unused, at dsa_indexer_kpool.py:862) and chunking against free memory.
      - SGLANG_DSA_INDEXER_QSPLIT=1
      # Opt-in observability (docker/sglang-glm53-hicache-w4afp8 v6; older images ignore it).
      # TP rank 0 only, off the serving path. The ghost prefix cache hashes each finished
      # request's pages into keyed digests (a 1/16 sample; tokens never leave the engine)
      # on a background thread and exports sglang:ghost_*. Every engine in this CVM shares the
      # key on the in-memory ghost volume and sends its digests to glm53-ghost-aggregator,
      # without ever blocking: if the aggregator is down the sends are dropped and counted.
      # The KV tier metrics export sglang:kv_tier_* (VRAM/DRAM evictions, load-backs, tier sizes).
      - SGLANG_GHOST_CACHE=1
      - SGLANG_GHOST_CACHE_SAMPLE=16
      - SGLANG_GHOST_CACHE_KEY_FILE=/ghost/key
      - SGLANG_GHOST_CACHE_SOCKET=/ghost/aggregator.sock
      - SGLANG_GHOST_CACHE_REPLICA=r2
      - SGLANG_KV_TIER_METRICS=1
      # v7 (opt-in in the image): the preprocess pool (SGLANG_PREPROCESS_WORKERS=0 is the old single-thread path)
      # and the tool-schema caps (0 = off). Profiling is off (no self-profile variables).
      - SGLANG_PREPROCESS_WORKERS=4
      - SGLANG_PREPROCESS_TIMEOUT_S=60
      - SGLANG_PREPROCESS_LOG_SLOW_S=5
      - SGLANG_TOOL_SCHEMA_MAX_DEPTH=32
      - SGLANG_TOOL_SCHEMA_MAX_NODES=25000
    depends_on:
      model-downloader:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          devices:
            - driver: nvidia
              device_ids: ["2","3"]
              capabilities: [gpu]
    labels:
      com.datadoghq.ad.logs: '[{"source":"sglang","service":"sglang","tags":["model:z-ai/glm-5.3-flash","model_path:graphistry/GLM-5.3-Flash-W4AFP8","served_model:z-ai/glm-5.3-flash","precision:int4-weights-fp8-activations-fp8-kv","deployment:glm53-flash-sgl-tp2x4","config_variant:w4afp8-qsplit-hicacheoff-mamba380-fp8kv-memopt086-mr64-c8192-admission-reserve-v10-pdi2-h200-tp2-ep2-eagle-fixed-4-1-5-strict-budget8192-obs-v1-v12-q8","request_logging:disabled","engine_image:da8d4e4b5ec6","env:${ENV}","host:${CVM_HOST}","ip:${HOST_IP}","port:8000","instance:2"]}]'
      nearai.otel.scrape: "true"
      nearai.otel.job: "sglang"
      nearai.otel.service: "sglang"
      nearai.otel.source: "sglang"
      nearai.otel.container_name: "model-sg-glm53-w4afp8-tp2-r2"
      nearai.otel.port: "8000"
      nearai.otel.path: "/metrics"
      nearai.otel.model: "z-ai/glm-5.3-flash"
      nearai.otel.model_path: "graphistry/GLM-5.3-Flash-W4AFP8"
      nearai.otel.served_model: "z-ai/glm-5.3-flash"
      nearai.otel.deployment: "glm53-flash-sgl-tp2x4"
      nearai.otel.config_variant: "w4afp8-qsplit-hicacheoff-mamba380-fp8kv-memopt086-mr64-c8192-admission-reserve-v10-pdi2-h200-tp2-ep2-eagle-fixed-4-1-5-strict-budget8192-obs-v1-v12-q8"
      nearai.otel.thinking_budget_policy: "default8192-public-to-native"
      nearai.otel.request_logging: "disabled"
      nearai.otel.engine_image: "da8d4e4b5ec6"
      nearai.otel.instance: "2"
      nearai.otel.env: "${ENV}"
      nearai.otel.host: "${CVM_HOST}"
      nearai.otel.host_machine: "${CVM_HOST}"
      nearai.otel.cvm_name: "${CVM_NAME}"
      nearai.otel.ip: "${HOST_IP}"
