  # --- GLM-5.3-Flash engine replica 4 (SGLang TP2, GPUs 6-7) ---
  model-sg-glm53-w4afp8-tp2-r4:
    <<: *sg-glm53-flash-candidate
    container_name: model-sg-glm53-w4afp8-tp2-r4
    environment:
      - HF_TOKEN=${HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN}
      # Local snapshot path; nothing is fetched at engine start.
      - HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
      - TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
      - HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1
      - DO_NOT_TRACK=1
      - NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES=compute,utility
      - OPENBLAS_L2_SIZE=2097152
      - NCCL_DEBUG=WARN
      - PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
      - TORCHINDUCTOR_CACHE_DIR=/root/.cache/torchinductor
      - TRITON_CACHE_DIR=/root/.cache/triton
      # Persist tilelang's DSA kernel JIT cache: it defaults to /root/.tilelang, outside
      # the kernel_cache volume, so every restart re-paid ~22-24 compiles at 8-9 s each
      # with the whole engine frozen (2026-09-12..16 capacity campaign).
      - TILELANG_CACHE_DIR=/root/.cache/tilelang
      # /health must not run a generation: at this pin health_generate submits a real
      # 1-token request that queues behind any in-flight long prefill, so the CVM
      # proxy's 3 s probe times out, the replica flaps unhealthy, and the conversation
      # affinity pin is skipped (full re-prefill on the other replica). nearai/infra#234.
      - SGLANG_ENABLE_HEALTH_ENDPOINT_GENERATION=0
      # Admission-reserve v10 (carried by this image): reserve up to 4096 tokens of each
      # 8192-token prefill chunk for waiting requests, sized on their uncached extend length,
      # bounded so the in-flight long prefill keeps >=25% of the chunk, and refunded when no
      # waiter used it. Pairs with --prefill-decode-interval 1 so admitted requests also decode.
      # Measured (2026-09-12..16 campaign): <=2K prompts p95 TTFT 19.6 s -> 0.6 s; cost ITL p90
      # 30 -> ~240 ms, median unchanged. The patch is inert with the reserve unset (rollback).
      # NEVER set SGLANG_ADMISSION_RESERVE_MIN_WAIT_S (wall-clock gate desyncs the TP ranks; v10
      # raises) or SGLANG_ADMISSION_RESERVE_MIN_ITERS (unmeasured in production).
      - SGLANG_CHUNKED_PREFILL_ADMISSION_RESERVE=4096
      - SGLANG_ADMISSION_RESERVE_MAX_FRACTION=0.75
      - SGLANG_ENABLE_STRICT_MEM_CHECK_DURING_IDLE=1
      # v7 fleet: HiCache is OFF (no --enable-hierarchical-cache in the argv), so the HiCache variables below are
      # unread, exactly as gpu03 r3 runs. They stay so re-enabling is an argv-only change.
      # HiCache host tier: a fixed 325 GiB per replica across its two TP ranks, 1,300 GiB for
      # the four replicas (the lab arm's DRAM total per 8 GPUs; ~5.87M tokens per replica). A
      # percentage would resolve against MemAvailable at each start, so the replicas started
      # later would get less; startup fails if it exceeds available RAM minus 10 GiB.
      - SGLANG_HICACHE_RAM_BUDGET=${GLM53_HICACHE_RAM_BUDGET:-325GiB}
      # CUDA-owned host memory (cudaMallocHost). Must stay 1 on TEE hosts: 0 selects
      # cudaHostRegister, which fails with CUDA error 801 under HCC/PPCIe.
      - SGLANG_HICACHE_CUDA_HOST_MEMORY=${GLM53_HICACHE_CUDA_HOST_MEMORY:-1}
      - SGLANG_HICACHE_POOLED_TRANSFERS=1
      - SGLANG_HICACHE_STAGING_PAGES=64
      # DSA indexer query split. Each TP rank scores 1/TP of a prefill chunk's rows instead of
      # all of them, so the fp32 logits buffer -- sized new_tokens x total_context -- shrinks
      # by TP (halves at TP2). gpu02's long-tier r1 crashed on 2026-09-25 without it:
      # deep_gemm.fp8_mqa_logits asked for 11.96 GiB with 11.88 GiB free at ~392K context
      # (dsa_indexer_kpool.py:919). This is a MITIGATION, not the fix: it divides the buffer
      # by TP and does not bound it. The real fix is calling _should_chunk_mqa_logits
      # (defined, unused, at dsa_indexer_kpool.py:862) and chunking against free memory.
      - SGLANG_DSA_INDEXER_QSPLIT=1
      # Opt-in observability (docker/sglang-glm53-hicache-w4afp8 v6; older images ignore it).

      # request's pages into keyed digests (a 1/16 sample; tokens never leave the engine)
      # on a background thread and exports sglang:ghost_*. Every engine in this CVM shares the
      # key on the in-memory ghost volume and sends its digests to glm53-ghost-aggregator,
      # without ever blocking: if the aggregator is down the sends are dropped and counted.
      # The KV tier metrics export sglang:kv_tier_* (VRAM/DRAM evictions, load-backs, tier sizes).
      - SGLANG_GHOST_CACHE=1
      - SGLANG_GHOST_CACHE_SAMPLE=16
      - SGLANG_GHOST_CACHE_KEY_FILE=/ghost/key
      - SGLANG_GHOST_CACHE_SOCKET=/ghost/aggregator.sock
      - SGLANG_GHOST_CACHE_REPLICA=r4
      - SGLANG_KV_TIER_METRICS=1
      # v7 (opt-in in the image): the preprocess pool (SGLANG_PREPROCESS_WORKERS=0 is the old single-thread path)

      - SGLANG_PREPROCESS_LOG_SLOW_S=5
      - SGLANG_TOOL_SCHEMA_MAX_DEPTH=32

  # Explicit operator-only semantic check; never starts with a normal stack apply.
  # Runs the candidate's synthetic fixture gate against each replica at concurrency 1.

  glm53-perception-check:
    image: docker.io/nearaidev/sglang@sha256:e9d29a1cb1cd65284392c4d62d5f2a36669628057e15c60fe93ea40cfe4fc7e7
    container_name: glm53-perception-check
    profiles: ["verification"]
    runtime: runc
    user: "65534:65534"
    read_only: true
    cap_drop: [ALL]
    security_opt: ["no-new-privileges:true"]
    restart: "no"
    mem_limit: 512m
    cpus: 1
    environment:
      - NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=void
      - PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
    entrypoint: ["/usr/bin/python3", "-u", "-c"]
    command:
      - |
        import json, runpy, shutil, sys, urllib.request
        print(json.dumps({"event": "disk", "free_bytes": shutil.disk_usage("/").free}), flush=True)
        failed = False
        for replica in (1, 2, 3, 4):
            base = f"http://model-sg-glm53-w4afp8-tp2-r{replica}:8000"
            print(json.dumps({"event": "replica", "replica": replica}), flush=True)
            for path in ("/health", "/v1/models"):
                with urllib.request.urlopen(base + path, timeout=30) as response:
                    assert response.status == 200
                    if path == "/v1/models":
                        assert "z-ai/glm-5.3-flash" in [row["id"] for row in json.load(response)["data"]]
            sys.argv = ["perception", "--base-url", base, "--size", "512", "--concurrency", "1", "--timeout", "300"]
            try:
                runpy.run_path("/sgl-workspace/sglang/test/manual/test_glm5_next_perception.py", run_name="__main__")
            except SystemExit as result:
                failed = failed or bool(result.code)

      nearai.otel.source: "sglang-ghost-aggregator"
      nearai.otel.container_name: "glm53-ghost-aggregator"
      nearai.otel.port: "9464"
      nearai.otel.path: "/metrics"

      events { worker_connections 64; }

        access_log off;
        client_max_body_size 100m;
        client_body_timeout 3600s;
        send_timeout 3600s;
        resolver 127.0.0.11 valid=5s ipv6=off;
        map_hash_bucket_size 256;
        map $$http_authorization $$soak_authorized {
          default 0;
          "Bearer ${PROXY_TOKEN:?PROXY_TOKEN required for authenticated soak access}" 1;
        }
        ssl_certificate /etc/letsencrypt/live/completions.near.ai/fullchain.pem;
        ssl_certificate_key /etc/letsencrypt/live/completions.near.ai/privkey.pem;
        ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_request_buffering off;
        proxy_buffering off;
        proxy_max_temp_file_size 0;
        proxy_connect_timeout 10s;
        proxy_read_timeout 3600s;
        proxy_send_timeout 3600s;
        proxy_set_header Authorization "";
        proxy_set_header Connection "";
        proxy_next_upstream off;
        server {
          listen 8008 ssl;
          server_name _;
          if ($$soak_authorized = 0) { return 401; }
          set $$backend http://model-sg-glm53-w4afp8-tp2-r1:8000;
          location ~ ^/(health|metrics|v1/models|v1/chat/completions|v1/completions|v1/responses)$$ {

          }

        }
        server {

          server_name _;
          if ($$soak_authorized = 0) { return 401; }

      # NEAR AI H200 operational collector for DCGM 4.6.0 / exporter 4.8.3.
      # Format: DCGM field, Prometheus type, help message.

      # Clocks, temperature, power and cumulative GPU-board energy.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_SM_CLOCK, gauge, SM clock frequency in MHz.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_MEM_CLOCK, gauge, Memory clock frequency in MHz.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_MEMORY_TEMP, gauge, Memory temperature in C.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP, gauge, GPU temperature in C.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_USAGE, gauge, GPU board power draw in W.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_TOTAL_ENERGY_CONSUMPTION, counter, GPU board energy consumed since boot in mJ.

      # Utilization, framebuffer and PCIe.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL, gauge, GPU utilization in percent.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_MEM_COPY_UTIL, gauge, Memory copy utilization in percent.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_FREE, gauge, Framebuffer memory free in MiB.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED, gauge, Framebuffer memory used in MiB.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_RESERVED, gauge, Framebuffer memory reserved in MiB.
      DCGM_FI_PROF_PCIE_TX_BYTES, gauge, PCIe transmit throughput in bytes per second.
      DCGM_FI_PROF_PCIE_RX_BYTES, gauge, PCIe receive throughput in bytes per second.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_PCIE_REPLAY_COUNTER, counter, Total PCIe replay events.

      # Raw and exporter-owned incident signals. Windowed counts provide a
      # stable zero series; cumulative totals preserve observed event labels.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_XID_ERRORS, gauge, Last XID error encountered.
      DCGM_EXP_XID_ERRORS_COUNT, gauge, XID records observed in the configured window.
      DCGM_EXP_XID_ERRORS_TOTAL, counter, XID records observed since exporter start.
      DCGM_EXP_CLOCK_EVENTS_COUNT, gauge, Clock events observed in the configured window.
      DCGM_EXP_CLOCK_EVENTS_TOTAL, counter, Clock event transitions observed since exporter start.
      DCGM_EXP_GPU_HEALTH_STATUS, gauge, Current DCGM GPU health status by health watch.
      DCGM_EXP_P2P_STATUS, gauge, Current NVLink P2P status for each ordered GPU pair.

      # Throttling and reliability constraints.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_VIOLATION, counter, Throttling duration due to power constraints in ns.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_THERMAL_VIOLATION, counter, Throttling duration due to thermal constraints in ns.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_SYNC_BOOST_VIOLATION, counter, Throttling duration due to sync boost constraints in ns.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_BOARD_LIMIT_VIOLATION, counter, Throttling duration due to board constraints in ns.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_LOW_UTIL_VIOLATION, counter, Throttling duration due to low utilization in ns.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_RELIABILITY_VIOLATION, counter, Throttling duration due to reliability constraints in ns.

      # ECC, retired pages and row remapping.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_ECC_SBE_VOL_TOTAL, counter, Total volatile single-bit ECC errors.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_ECC_DBE_VOL_TOTAL, counter, Total volatile double-bit ECC errors.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_ECC_SBE_AGG_TOTAL, counter, Total aggregate single-bit ECC errors.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_ECC_DBE_AGG_TOTAL, counter, Total aggregate double-bit ECC errors.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_RETIRED_SBE, counter, Total pages retired due to single-bit errors.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_RETIRED_DBE, counter, Total pages retired due to double-bit errors.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_RETIRED_PENDING, counter, Pages pending retirement.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_UNCORRECTABLE_REMAPPED_ROWS, counter, Total uncorrectable remapped rows.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_CORRECTABLE_REMAPPED_ROWS, counter, Total correctable remapped rows.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_ROW_REMAP_FAILURE, gauge, Whether row remapping has failed.

      # NVLink traffic and integrity.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_NVLINK_BANDWIDTH_TOTAL, gauge, Aggregate NVLink traffic rate across all lanes.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_NVLINK_CRC_FLIT_ERROR_COUNT_TOTAL, counter, Total NVLink flow-control CRC errors.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_NVLINK_CRC_DATA_ERROR_COUNT_TOTAL, counter, Total NVLink data CRC errors.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_NVLINK_REPLAY_ERROR_COUNT_TOTAL, counter, Total NVLink replay errors.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_NVLINK_RECOVERY_ERROR_COUNT_TOTAL, counter, Total NVLink recovery errors.

      # Workload profiling. Unsupported fields are skipped by DCGM and must be
      # represented as unsupported in Grafana rather than coerced to zero.
      DCGM_FI_PROF_GR_ENGINE_ACTIVE, gauge, Ratio of time the graphics engine is active.
      DCGM_FI_PROF_PIPE_TENSOR_ACTIVE, gauge, Ratio of cycles the tensor pipe is active.
      DCGM_FI_PROF_DRAM_ACTIVE, gauge, Ratio of time the device memory interface is active.

      # Stable software identity labels attached to emitted GPU metrics.
      DCGM_FI_DRIVER_VERSION, label, NVIDIA driver version.
      DCGM_FI_NVML_VERSION, label, NVML version.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_BRAND, label, GPU product brand.
      DCGM_FI_DEV_VBIOS_VERSION, label, GPU VBIOS version.

  registrar_script:
    content: |
      #!/bin/sh
      PROXY_URL="https://completions.near.ai"
      TOKEN="$${MODEL_PROXY_TOKEN}"
      INFERENCE_TOKEN="$${PROXY_TOKEN}"

      if [ -z "$$TOKEN" ] || [ -z "$$INFERENCE_TOKEN" ]; then
        echo "ERROR: MODEL_PROXY_TOKEN and PROXY_TOKEN are required for model-proxy registration"
        exit 1
      fi

      ENDPOINT="$${HOST_IP}:$${HTTP_PORT}"
      REGISTERED=false
      FAILURE_COUNT=0
      MAX_RETRIES=3

      register_endpoint() {
        echo "Registering endpoint $$1 with routing port $$2"
        curl -fsS --max-time 10 -X POST "$$PROXY_URL/register/endpoint" \
          -H "Authorization: Bearer $$TOKEN" \
          -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
          -d "{\"endpoint\":\"$$1\",\"routing_port\":$$2}"
      }

      unregister_endpoint() {
        echo "Unregistering endpoint $$1"
        curl -fsS --max-time 10 -X POST "$$PROXY_URL/unregister/endpoint" \
          -H "Authorization: Bearer $$TOKEN" \
          -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
          -d "{\"endpoint\":\"$$1\"}"
      }

      register_model() {
        curl -fsS --max-time 10 -X POST "$$PROXY_URL/register/model" \
          -H "Authorization: Bearer $$TOKEN" \
          -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
          -d "{\"model\":\"$$1\",\"domain\":\"$$2\"}"
      }

      cleanup() {
        echo "SIGTERM received, unregistering $$ENDPOINT"
        unregister_endpoint "$$ENDPOINT"
        REGISTERED=false
        exit 0
      }
      trap cleanup TERM INT

      mark_registered() {
        if ! register_endpoint "$$ENDPOINT" "$${TLS_PORT}"; then
          echo "[GLM-5.3-Flash-SGL-TP4] Endpoint registration failed; retrying on the next loop"
          return 1
        fi
        if ! register_model "z-ai/glm-5.3-flash" "glm-5-3-flash.completions.near.ai"; then
          echo "[GLM-5.3-Flash-SGL-TP4] Model registration failed; retrying on the next loop"
          return 1
        fi
        if [ "$$REGISTERED" = false ]; then
          echo "[GLM-5.3-Flash-SGL-TP4] Registered z-ai/glm-5.3-flash (4x TP2/EP2) at $$ENDPOINT"
        fi
        REGISTERED=true
      }

      # The previous mixed stack published its retired co-resident engine on
      # port 8001. Remove only this host-local endpoint; the global model-domain
      # mapping must remain while other hosts may still serve that model.
      unregister_endpoint "$${HOST_IP}:8001" || \
        echo "[GLM-5.3-Flash-SGL-TP4] WARN: legacy endpoint cleanup failed; continuing"

      # Probe the host-published nginx port. The inference-proxy health-manages
      # both internal replicas, so registration represents the pooled endpoint.
      check_inference() {
        status=$$(curl -sS --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 45 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" \
          -X POST "http://$${HOST_IP}:$${HTTP_PORT}/v1/chat/completions" \
          -H "Authorization: Bearer $$INFERENCE_TOKEN" \
          -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
          -d '{"model":"z-ai/glm-5.3-flash","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}],"max_tokens":1}')
        curl_status=$$?

        if [ "$$curl_status" -ne 0 ]; then
          case "$$curl_status" in
            52|56)
              echo "[GLM-5.3-Flash-SGL-TP4] Health probe hit connection-level backpressure (curl $$curl_status); treating as alive but saturated"
              return 2
              ;;
            28)
              # Probe timeout is NOT proof of death: a 1-token completion
              # queues behind long-context prefills and legitimately exceeds
              # 45s under prod load, with no 503/backpressure signal. Observed
              # 2026-09-17 on the GLM-5.3 long-context tier: with one replica
              # warming, the other's 250K-token prefills pushed a 1-token probe
              # past 45 s three times and the host unregistered itself while
              # serving fine. Disambiguate with a fast /v1/models probe - it
              # answers from the HTTP layer even at full queue depth, so 2xx
              # here means alive-but-saturated. Genuinely dead backends still
              # fail this and unregister; model-proxy's own /healthz checker +
              # breaker (PR#42) covers them within seconds regardless.
              if curl -sf --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 10 \
                -H "Authorization: Bearer $$INFERENCE_TOKEN" \
                "http://$${HOST_IP}:$${HTTP_PORT}/v1/models" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
                echo "[GLM-5.3-Flash-SGL-TP4] Health probe timed out but /v1/models is live; treating as alive but saturated"
                return 2
              fi
              echo "[GLM-5.3-Flash-SGL-TP4] Health probe timed out and /v1/models is unreachable"
              return 1
              ;;
          esac
          echo "[GLM-5.3-Flash-SGL-TP4] Health probe curl failed with status $$curl_status"
          return 1
        fi

        case "$$status" in
          2*)
            return 0
            ;;
          503)
            echo "[GLM-5.3-Flash-SGL-TP4] Backend returned 503; treating as alive but saturated"
            return 2
            ;;
          *)
            echo "[GLM-5.3-Flash-SGL-TP4] Backend returned HTTP $$status"
            return 1
            ;;
        esac
      }

      READY_URL="http://$${HOST_IP}:$${HTTP_PORT}/v1/models"
      echo "Waiting for model to be ready (probing $$READY_URL)..."
      ready_attempts=0
      until curl --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 10 -sf \
        -H "Authorization: Bearer $$INFERENCE_TOKEN" \
        "$$READY_URL" > /dev/null 2>&1; do
        ready_attempts=$$((ready_attempts + 1))
        if [ "$$ready_attempts" -ge 30 ]; then
          echo "WARN: model not reachable at $$READY_URL after $$ready_attempts attempts (~20m); entering registration loop anyway"
          break
        fi
        echo "Model not ready yet (attempt $$ready_attempts/30), retrying in 30s..."
        sleep 30
      done
      echo "Model ready, starting registration loop"

      while true; do
        date +%s > /tmp/registrar_alive
        check_inference
        health_status=$$?
        case "$$health_status" in
          0)
            if mark_registered; then
              FAILURE_COUNT=0
            else
              FAILURE_COUNT=$$((FAILURE_COUNT + 1))
            fi
            ;;
          2)
            echo "[GLM-5.3-Flash-SGL-TP4] Keeping $$ENDPOINT registered while backend is saturated"
            if mark_registered; then
              FAILURE_COUNT=0
            else
              FAILURE_COUNT=$$((FAILURE_COUNT + 1))
            fi
            ;;
          *)
            FAILURE_COUNT=$$((FAILURE_COUNT + 1))
            echo "[GLM-5.3-Flash-SGL-TP4] Health check failed ($$FAILURE_COUNT/$$MAX_RETRIES)"
            if [ "$$REGISTERED" = true ] && [ "$$FAILURE_COUNT" -ge "$$MAX_RETRIES" ]; then
              echo "[GLM-5.3-Flash-SGL-TP4] Retry limit reached, unregistering $$ENDPOINT"
              unregister_endpoint "$$ENDPOINT"
              REGISTERED=false
              echo "[GLM-5.3-Flash-SGL-TP4] Exiting to refresh DNS (container will auto-restart)"
              exit 1
            fi
            ;;
        esac
        sleep 60
      done
  nginx_conf:
    content: |
      log_format json_combined escape=json
        '{'  '"time":"$$time_iso8601"'
        ',"request_id":"$$http_x_request_id"'
        ',"org_id":"$$http_x_org_id"'
        ',"workspace_id":"$$http_x_workspace_id"'
        ',"http_host":"$$host"'
        ',"method":"$$request_method"'
        ',"uri":"$$uri"'
        ',"status":$$status'
        ',"request_length":$$request_length'
        ',"bytes_sent":$$bytes_sent'
        ',"request_time":$$request_time'
        ',"upstream_addr":"$$upstream_addr"'
        '}';

      access_log /var/log/nginx/access.log json_combined;

      proxy_http_version 1.1;
      proxy_set_header Host $$host;
      proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $$remote_addr;
      proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $$proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
      proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $$scheme;
      proxy_set_header Connection '';
      proxy_buffering off;
      proxy_cache off;
      proxy_read_timeout 3600s;
      client_max_body_size 100m;
      client_body_buffer_size 1m;

      # Resolve proxy-glm53 through Docker's embedded DNS at request time
      # (proxy_pass with a variable) instead of once at startup, so a recreated
      # proxy container with a new IP is picked up immediately rather than at
      # the next 6-hourly reload. Same pattern as the soak relay above.
      resolver 127.0.0.11 valid=5s ipv6=off;

      # :8000 - GLM-5.3-Flash
      server {
        listen 8000;
        location / {
          set $$proxy_glm53 http://proxy-glm53:8000;
          proxy_pass $$proxy_glm53;
        }
      }
      ssl_certificate /etc/letsencrypt/live/completions.near.ai/fullchain.pem;
      ssl_certificate_key /etc/letsencrypt/live/completions.near.ai/privkey.pem;
      ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;

      server {
        listen 443 ssl http2;
        server_name glm-5-3-flash.completions.near.ai
                    glm-5-3-flash.completions-stg.near.ai
                    ~^glm-5-3-flash-i\d+\.completions(-stg)?\.near\.ai$$;
        # Keep H2 connections from cloud-api alive across long idle gaps so the
        # bucket-pinned TCP connection survives between chats. Without this,
        # nginx defaults (75s idle, 1000 req/conn) close the connection and the
        # next request opens a new TCP via model-proxy's L4 LB → may land on a
        # different backend → signature 404. Pairs with cloud-api H2 keepalive
        # PINGs (http2_keep_alive_while_idle).
        keepalive_timeout 1h;
        keepalive_requests 1000000;
        location ^~ /metrics { return 404; }
        location ^~ /v1/metrics { return 404; }
        location / {
          set $$proxy_glm53 http://proxy-glm53:8000;
          proxy_pass $$proxy_glm53;
        }
      }
bodies.ddec8d8c4f637d16884ca949e43c51582d8ed858:
# GLM-5.2-W4AFP8-SGL-2xTP4 — PhalaCloud/GLM-5.2-W4AFP8 (INT4 experts + FP8 activations) on SGLang, 2x TP4.
#
# TOPOLOGY: two co-resident TP4 sglang backends (GPUs 0-3 and 4-7) behind a SINGLE
# nearaidev/vllm-proxy-rs that load-balances across both via VLLM_BACKEND_URLS
# (least-connections, per-backend health/failover). nginx -> proxy -> {r1, r2}.
# Same topology as GLM-5.1-SGL-AWQ-TP4.yaml, which this file is cloned from.
#
# WHY (glm52x campaign, gpu02-vm 2026-07-02/03, /dstack/persistent/bench/glm52x/REPORT.md):
#   - Prod GLM-5.2 TP8 pain was 3 things: unbounded queue (92% of the 28.3s weighted TTFT),
#     TP8 topology waste (comm-bound; 2xTP4 wins, as on 5.1), and — bench-side — all prior
#     TP4 evaluations ran a pre-IndexShare-fix image that generated garbage past ~2k tokens.
#   - W4AFP8 (~100 GB/GPU at TP4) fits 4xH200 with a 419k-token fp8 KV pool per replica
#     at ctx 262144 / mem-fraction 0.85.
#   - Measured (symmetric 2-replica load, quality-gated incl. 193k-token needle):
#     prod shape 44.9k in / 770 out @ 0.14 rps/replica: ~5.8k in tok/s per replica,
#     TTFT p95 <= 12s, TPOT p50 14-35 ms; box total ~11.5k in tok/s = > entire 07-02
#     GLM-5.2 fleet offered load on ONE box. ~$7.6/GPU-h revenue at $1.40/$4.40 pricing.
#     Co-residency retention 97.0% mean (no cross-replica all-reduce).
#     6h soak (131 rounds, continuous 94k-token probes): quality 6/6 every round.
#
# IMAGE: lmsysorg/sglang v0.5.14 (2026-06-26), pinned by digest. REQUIRED >= v0.5.13:
#   pre-IndexShare images serve GLM-5.2 long-context BROKEN (silent garbage past ~2k tok).
#   v0.5.14 additionally fixes the low-concurrency decode regression (#28363) that
#   v0.5.13.post1-era images carry, and PCG+DSA (#28644). Do NOT bump to ToT main without
#   re-validation (#29837 / #29954 load regressions were live as of 07-02).
#
# FLAGS (each measured, see REPORT.md):
#   --chunked-prefill-size 8192 / --max-prefill-tokens 16384 — Phala's shipped default.
#     The tuned 32768/32768 candidate (+15-17% bench throughput) is REJECTED for prod: its
#     first-heavy-prefill transient workspace OOMs TP4 ranks at 141 GB — see A/B verdict below.
#   --max-running-requests 96 — explicit: spec decode silently resets it to 48 otherwise.
#   --max-queued-requests 16 — bounded queue -> 503 -> cloud-api retry_with_fallback to the
#     peer replica/host (the fix for the prod queueing pathology; same as GLM-5.1).
#   --enforce-disable-flashinfer-allreduce-fusion — auto-enabled fusion has a prefill
#     regression (sglang #28912); Phala ships this flag too.
#   --cuda-graph-max-bs 64 — decode is KV-bound far below 64 at prod shapes; faster capture.
#   EAGLE 5/1/6 + SGLANG_ENABLE_SPEC_V2=1 — beats 3/1/4 and no-spec at EVERY load level at
#     TP4 (accept length ~3.1-4.6). Do NOT add mixed-chunk/num-continuous-decode-steps (5.1
#     IMA crash combo), --enable-two-batch-overlap (hard-rejected on DSA), or
#     --enable-dp-attention (EAGLE deadlock, sglang #29144).
#
# CONTEXT: 262144 (down from the TP8 file's 1M). Covers ~p97 of observed input sizes
#   (07-02 distribution: p95 197k, p99 318k, max 950k). The >262k tail CANNOT be served at
#   TP4 (419k-token KV pool); keep one TP8 host as the long-context tier during/after
#   rollout, or accept 400s on >262k until a routing tier exists. CATALOG contextLength
#   must be updated (customer-facing) before rollout.
#
# REVISION: pinned to 8dc3a42a (current HF default branch; the revision this campaign
#   quality-gated). The TP8 file pins the older d975c19a — do not mix.
#
# OPS (CC/TEE cold-start runbook, learned the hard way — see REPORT.md):
#   - Replica cold start is ~50 min (weight load + JIT + capture). compose-manager deploys:
#     down-then-up per host, ONE host at a time; the two replicas within a host stagger
#     their rendezvous via distinct --dist-init-addr ports (same 29500, isolated per-container namespace).
#   - Never kill -9 sglang ranks (D-state driver cleanup wedges the GPU ~15 min).
#   - Compile caches are per-replica volumes (compile_cache_a/b) — never share a live
#     cache between two cold-starting replicas (JIT write races corrupt kernels -> SIGILL).
#
# *** DIST-INIT (--dist-init-addr 127.0.0.1:295NN): ***
#   On the dstack bridge network, sglang's default distributed-init address resolves to
#   0.0.0.0 and TP rank rendezvous times out after 600s. Forcing loopback fixes it. The two
#   backends are in separate net namespaces, but distinct ports are used anyway for clarity.

x-logging-conf: &logging-conf
  driver: "json-file"
  options:
    max-size: "100m"
    max-file: "10"
    labels: "com.datadoghq.ad.logs,com.docker.compose.service"

x-nvidia: &nvidia
  runtime: nvidia
  ipc: host
  ulimits:
    memlock: -1
    nofile:
      soft: 65535
      hard: 65535

x-vllm-proxy-common: &vllm-proxy-common
  image: nearaidev/vllm-proxy-rs@sha256:b183677a5d32267539b9b21ec45327a4f3be0a013afeb608c68c4d76e9472e36
  user: root
  privileged: true
  <<: *nvidia
  extra_hosts:
    - "compose-manager:host-gateway"
  volumes:
    - /var/run/dstack.sock:/var/run/dstack.sock
    - certs:/etc/letsencrypt:ro
  restart: unless-stopped
  logging: *logging-conf

x-downloader-common: &downloader-common
  image: ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:python3.11-bookworm-slim@sha256:4f5d923c9dcea037f57bda425dd209f3ec643da2f0b74227f68d09dab0b3bb36
  entrypoint: ["sh", "-c"]
  restart: "no"
  logging: *logging-conf

# Shared sglang args (identical across both backends - keep tuning here so the
# two replicas never drift). Flags rationale in the header; measurements in REPORT.md.
# ===== PREFILL A/B VERDICT (2026-07-16): both replicas converged on the 8192/16384 budget =====
# The A/B (r1: cookbook 32768/32768 candidate vs r2: Phala default 8192/16384) was decided
# by STABILITY, not TTFT. r1's 32k budget needs a ~3.5-4 GiB transient workspace per rank on
# its first heavy prefill, and OOM'd at BOTH mem-fractions tried:
#   - 0.85: 4.02 GiB alloc vs ~3.4 GiB free -> deterministic boot-loop (2026-07-09/10,
#     ~30 cycles; the repeated hard kills also wedged the CVM's NVML/NVSwitch state,
#     requiring a host-side vmm-cli VM restart on 07-13).
#   - 0.82 (#137 hotfix): survived 2 days of light traffic, then 3.47 GiB alloc vs
#     2.73 GiB free -> crash-looped all of 07-15; r1 stopped via dashboard 20:46 CEST.
# r2 (8192/16384 @0.85) served the same live traffic mix without a single OOM throughout.
# mem-fraction 0.85 is safe WITH the 8192/16384 budget (workspace stays small); the KV pool
# regained by 0.85 over the hotfix's 0.82 is ~73k tokens (~381k vs ~308k, ctx 262144).
# Do NOT raise the prefill budget without re-running the full OOM math on 141 GB H200s.
x-glm52-cmd: &glm52-cmd >
  sglang serve
  --model-path PhalaCloud/GLM-5.2-W4AFP8
  --revision 8dc3a42a45cf2a6c47d241fd2c226afde73f1316
  --served-model-name z-ai/glm-5.2
  --quantization w4afp8
  --tp 4
  --dist-init-addr 127.0.0.1:29500
  --disable-shared-experts-fusion
  --disable-custom-all-reduce
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3
  --reasoning-parser glm45
  --tool-call-parser glm47
  --log-requests-level 0
  --mem-fraction-static 0.85
  --context-length 262144
  --chunked-prefill-size 8192
  --max-prefill-tokens 16384
  --max-running-requests 96
  --max-queued-requests 16
  --cuda-graph-max-bs 64
  --enforce-disable-flashinfer-allreduce-fusion
  --speculative-algorithm EAGLE
  --speculative-num-steps 5
  --speculative-eagle-topk 1
  --speculative-num-draft-tokens 6
  --watchdog-timeout 1800
  --port 8000
  --host 0.0.0.0
  --enable-cache-report
  --enable-metrics
  --trust-remote-code

x-glm52-model-env: &glm52-model-env
  HF_TOKEN: ${HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN}
  HF_HUB_OFFLINE: ${HF_HUB_OFFLINE:-0}
  NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES: compute,utility
  OPENBLAS_L2_SIZE: "2097152"
  NCCL_DEBUG: WARN
  # EAGLE spec-decode uses the V2 worker path (topk=1 chain). Validated config.
  SGLANG_ENABLE_SPEC_V2: "1"
  # Persist the inductor/triton compile caches so an UNCHANGED config skips
  # RECOMPILE on restart (default: ephemeral /tmp/torchinductor_root + /root/.triton,
  # wiped on container recreate). Content-addressed, so a changed config only
  # misses the kernels that actually changed.
  # MEASURED CAVEAT (campaign iter 7-8): this saves only the compile slice
  # (~10-15min). The DOMINANT startup cost is weight-load (~11min) + cuda-graph
  # capture-RECORD (~12min), both per-process and NOT file-cacheable — so restart
  # is somewhat faster, NOT an instant warm replay (~40min cold stays ~25-30min).
  TORCHINDUCTOR_CACHE_DIR: /root/.cache/torchinductor
  TRITON_CACHE_DIR: /root/.cache/triton

services:
  model-downloader:
    <<: *downloader-common
    container_name: model-downloader
    command:
      - |
        set -e
        echo "Downloading PhalaCloud/GLM-5.2-W4AFP8..."
        uvx --from 'huggingface_hub[hf_xet]' hf download PhalaCloud/GLM-5.2-W4AFP8 --revision 8dc3a42a45cf2a6c47d241fd2c226afde73f1316
        echo "Download complete."
    volumes:
      - huggingface_cache:/root/.cache/huggingface
    environment:
      - HF_TOKEN=${HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN}
    labels:
      com.datadoghq.ad.logs: '[{"source":"model-downloader","service":"model-downloader","tags":["model:PhalaCloud/GLM-5.2-W4AFP8","deployment:GLM-5.2-W4AFP8-SGL-2xTP4","env:${ENV}","host:${CVM_HOST}","ip:${HOST_IP}"]}]'

  nginx:
    image: nginx@sha256:1d13701a5f9f3fb01aaa88cef2344d65b6b5bf6b7d9fa4cf0dca557a8d7702ba
    container_name: nginx
    depends_on:
      - proxy-glm52
    command: /bin/sh -c 'cert=/etc/letsencrypt/live/completions.near.ai/fullchain.pem; last=$$(stat -L -c %Y "$$cert" 2>/dev/null); while :; do sleep 60; cur=$$(stat -L -c %Y "$$cert" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$$cur" ] && [ "$$cur" != "$$last" ]; then last=$$cur; echo "$$cert changed, reloading nginx"; nginx -s reload; fi; done & while :; do sleep 6h; nginx -s reload; done & nginx -g "daemon off;"'
    ports:
      - "8000:80"
      - "8444:443"
    volumes:
      - certs:/etc/letsencrypt:ro
    configs:
      - source: nginx_conf
        target: /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
        mode: 0644
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging: *logging-conf
    labels:
      com.datadoghq.ad.logs: '[{"source":"nginx","service":"nginx","tags":["model:PhalaCloud/GLM-5.2-W4AFP8","deployment:GLM-5.2-W4AFP8-SGL-2xTP4","env:${ENV}","host:${CVM_HOST}","ip:${HOST_IP}","port:8000"]}]'

  model-proxy-registrar:
    image: curlimages/curl@sha256:d94d07ba9e7d6de898b6d96c1a072f6f8266c687af78a74f380087a0addf5d17
    container_name: model-proxy-registrar
    entrypoint: ["sh", "/register.sh"]
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "[ $$(( $$(date +%s) - $$(cat /tmp/registrar_alive 2>/dev/null || echo 0) )) -lt 180 ]"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 1200s
    environment:
      - HOST_IP=${HOST_IP}
      - HTTP_PORT=${HTTP_PORT:-8000}
      - TLS_PORT=${TLS_PORT:-8444}
      - MODEL_PROXY_TOKEN=${MODEL_PROXY_TOKEN}
      - PROXY_TOKEN=${PROXY_TOKEN}
    configs:
      - source: registrar_script
        target: /register.sh
        mode: 0755
    logging: *logging-conf
    labels:
      com.datadoghq.ad.logs: '[{"source":"model-proxy-registrar","service":"model-proxy-registrar","tags":["model:PhalaCloud/GLM-5.2-W4AFP8","deployment:GLM-5.2-W4AFP8-SGL-2xTP4","env:${ENV}","host:${CVM_HOST}","ip:${HOST_IP}"]}]'

  # Single proxy fronting BOTH TP4 backends (VLLM_BACKEND_URLS = least-conn pool).
  proxy-glm52:
    <<: *vllm-proxy-common
    container_name: proxy-glm52
    environment:
      - NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=all
      - CLOUD_API_URL=https://cloud-api.near.ai
      - CLOUD_API_USAGE_TOKEN=${CLOUD_API_USAGE_TOKEN}
      - COMPOSE_MANAGER_URL=http://compose-manager:8080
      - LOG_FORMAT=json
      - MODEL_NAME=z-ai/glm-5.2
      - OHTTP_ENABLED=true
      - TOKEN=${PROXY_TOKEN}
      - FUSION_ENABLED=${FUSION_ENABLED}
      - FUSION_INTERNAL_BEARER_TOKEN=${FUSION_INTERNAL_BEARER_TOKEN}
      - VLLM_BACKEND_URLS=http://model-sg-glm52-w4a-tp4-r1:8000,http://model-sg-glm52-w4a-tp4-r2:8000
      - TLS_CERT_PATH=/etc/letsencrypt/live/completions.near.ai/fullchain.pem
      - USE_NV_ATTESTATION_SDK=true
      - WEB_CONTEXT_SEARCH_URL=${WEB_CONTEXT_SEARCH_URL}
      - WEB_CONTEXT_SEARCH_API_KEY=${WEB_CONTEXT_SEARCH_API_KEY}
    labels:
      com.datadoghq.ad.logs: '[{"source":"vllm-proxy","service":"vllm-proxy","tags":["model:z-ai/glm-5.2","deployment:GLM-5.2-W4AFP8-SGL-2xTP4","env:${ENV}","host:${CVM_HOST}","ip:${HOST_IP}","port:8000"]}]'
      nearai.otel.scrape: "true"
      nearai.otel.job: "inference-proxy"
      nearai.otel.service: "vllm-proxy"
      nearai.otel.source: "vllm-proxy"
      nearai.otel.container_name: "proxy-glm52"
      nearai.otel.port: "8000"
      nearai.otel.path: "/metrics"
      nearai.otel.model: "z-ai/glm-5.2"
      nearai.otel.deployment: "GLM-5.2-W4AFP8-SGL-2xTP4"
      nearai.otel.env: "${ENV}"
      nearai.otel.host: "${CVM_HOST}"
      nearai.otel.host_machine: "${CVM_HOST}"
      nearai.otel.cvm_name: "${CVM_NAME}"
      nearai.otel.ip: "${HOST_IP}"

  model-sg-glm52-w4a-tp4-r1:
    <<: *nvidia
    init: true
    depends_on:
      model-downloader:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    image: lmsysorg/sglang@sha256:5027e95bf6ec536856b1b52a91d1f35ff5c564ab83e8a94758a169ff09bb8df3  # v0.5.14 (2026-06-26)
    container_name: model-sg-glm52-w4a-tp4-r1
    command: *glm52-cmd
    volumes:
      # compile_cache_a at /root/.cache persists inductor + triton + deep_gemm +
      # flashinfer for replica a; huggingface_cache nests under it (shared weights).
      - compile_cache_a:/root/.cache
      - huggingface_cache:/root/.cache/huggingface
    environment: *glm52-model-env
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          devices:
            - driver: nvidia
              device_ids: ["0","1","2","3"]
              capabilities: [gpu]
    restart: unless-stopped
    stop_grace_period: 5m
    logging: *logging-conf
    labels:
      com.datadoghq.ad.logs: '[{"source":"sglang","service":"sglang","tags":["model:PhalaCloud/GLM-5.2-W4AFP8","deployment:GLM-5.2-W4AFP8-SGL-2xTP4","env:${ENV}","host:${CVM_HOST}","ip:${HOST_IP}","port:8000","instance:1"]}]'
      nearai.otel.scrape: "true"
      nearai.otel.job: "sglang"
      nearai.otel.service: "sglang"
      nearai.otel.source: "sglang"
      nearai.otel.container_name: "model-sg-glm52-w4a-tp4-r1"
      nearai.otel.port: "8000"
      nearai.otel.path: "/metrics"
      nearai.otel.model: "PhalaCloud/GLM-5.2-W4AFP8"
      nearai.otel.deployment: "GLM-5.2-W4AFP8-SGL-2xTP4"
      nearai.otel.env: "${ENV}"
      nearai.otel.host: "${CVM_HOST}"
      nearai.otel.host_machine: "${CVM_HOST}"
      nearai.otel.cvm_name: "${CVM_NAME}"
      nearai.otel.ip: "${HOST_IP}"

  model-sg-glm52-w4a-tp4-r2:
    <<: *nvidia
    init: true
    depends_on:
      model-downloader:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    image: lmsysorg/sglang@sha256:5027e95bf6ec536856b1b52a91d1f35ff5c564ab83e8a94758a169ff09bb8df3  # v0.5.14 (2026-06-26)
    container_name: model-sg-glm52-w4a-tp4-r2
    command: *glm52-cmd
    volumes:
      - compile_cache_b:/root/.cache
      - huggingface_cache:/root/.cache/huggingface
    environment: *glm52-model-env
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          devices:
            - driver: nvidia
              device_ids: ["4","5","6","7"]
              capabilities: [gpu]
    restart: unless-stopped
    stop_grace_period: 5m
    logging: *logging-conf
    labels:
      com.datadoghq.ad.logs: '[{"source":"sglang","service":"sglang","tags":["model:PhalaCloud/GLM-5.2-W4AFP8","deployment:GLM-5.2-W4AFP8-SGL-2xTP4","env:${ENV}","host:${CVM_HOST}","ip:${HOST_IP}","port:8000","instance:2"]}]'

networks:
  default:
    external: true
    name: dstack_default

volumes:
  otelcol_app_storage:
  huggingface_cache:
  compile_cache_a:   # persisted inductor/triton/deep_gemm for replica a (warm restarts)
  compile_cache_b:
  certs:
    external: true
    name: certs

configs:
  otelcol_app_config:
    content: |
      receivers:
        otlp:
          protocols:
            grpc:
              endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4317
            http:
              endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4318

        filelog/docker_containers:
          include: [/var/lib/docker/containers/*/*-json.log]
          start_at: end
          storage: file_storage
          include_file_path: true
          operators:
            - type: json_parser
              parse_from: body
              parse_to: attributes
              timestamp:
                parse_from: attributes.time
                layout_type: gotime
                layout: '2006-01-02T15:04:05.999999999Z07:00'
              on_error: send_quiet
            - type: move
              from: attributes.log
              to: body
              if: 'attributes.log != nil'
            - type: move
              from: attributes.stream
              to: attributes["log.iostream"]
              if: 'attributes.stream != nil'
            - type: remove
              field: attributes.time
              if: 'attributes.time != nil'
            - type: regex_parser
              parse_from: attributes["log.file.path"]
              regex: '/var/lib/docker/containers/(?P<container_id>[a-f0-9]{12})[a-f0-9]*/'
              on_error: send_quiet
            - type: regex_parser
              parse_from: attributes["attrs"]["com.datadoghq.ad.logs"]
              regex: 'model:(?P<model>[^",\]]+)'
              on_error: send_quiet
            - type: regex_parser
              parse_from: attributes["attrs"]["com.datadoghq.ad.logs"]
              regex: 'model_path:(?P<model_path>[^",\]]+)'
              on_error: send_quiet
            - type: regex_parser
              parse_from: attributes["attrs"]["com.datadoghq.ad.logs"]
              regex: 'precision:(?P<precision>[^",\]]+)'
              on_error: send_quiet
            - type: regex_parser
              parse_from: attributes["attrs"]["com.datadoghq.ad.logs"]
              regex: 'deployment:(?P<deployment>[^",\]]+)'
              on_error: send_quiet
            - type: regex_parser
              parse_from: attributes["attrs"]["com.datadoghq.ad.logs"]
              regex: 'ip:(?P<ip>[^",\]]+)'
              on_error: send_quiet
            - type: regex_parser
              parse_from: attributes["attrs"]["com.datadoghq.ad.logs"]
              regex: 'port:(?P<port>[^",\]]+)'
              on_error: send_quiet
            - type: regex_parser
              parse_from: attributes["attrs"]["com.datadoghq.ad.logs"]
              regex: 'env:(?P<env>[^",\]]+)'
              on_error: send_quiet
            - type: regex_parser
              parse_from: attributes["attrs"]["com.datadoghq.ad.logs"]
              regex: 'host:(?P<host>[^",\]]+)'
              on_error: send_quiet
            - type: regex_parser
              parse_from: attributes["attrs"]["com.datadoghq.ad.logs"]
              regex: 'instance:(?P<instance>[^",\]]+)'
              on_error: send_quiet
            - type: regex_parser
              parse_from: attributes["attrs"]["com.datadoghq.ad.logs"]
              regex: 'replica:(?P<replica>[^",\]]+)'
              on_error: send_quiet
            - type: add
              field: attributes["service.name"]
              value: cvm-docker

        prometheus/apps:
          config:
            scrape_configs:
              - job_name: sglang-model-sg-glm52-w4a-tp4-r1
                scrape_interval: 15s
                metrics_path: /metrics
                static_configs:
                  - targets: ['model-sg-glm52-w4a-tp4-r1:8000']
                    labels:
                      service: "sglang"
                      source: "sglang"
                      container_name: "model-sg-glm52-w4a-tp4-r1"
                      model: "PhalaCloud/GLM-5.2-W4AFP8"
                      deployment: "GLM-5.2-W4AFP8-SGL-2xTP4"
                      env: "${ENV}"
                      host: "${CVM_HOST}"
                      host_machine: "${CVM_HOST}"
                      cvm_name: "${CVM_NAME}"
                      ip: "${HOST_IP}"
                      port: "8000"
                      instance: "1"
              - job_name: sglang-model-sg-glm52-w4a-tp4-r2
                scrape_interval: 15s
                metrics_path: /metrics
                static_configs:
                  - targets: ['model-sg-glm52-w4a-tp4-r2:8000']
                    labels:
                      service: "sglang"
                      source: "sglang"
                      container_name: "model-sg-glm52-w4a-tp4-r2"
                      model: "PhalaCloud/GLM-5.2-W4AFP8"
                      deployment: "GLM-5.2-W4AFP8-SGL-2xTP4"
                      env: "${ENV}"
                      host: "${CVM_HOST}"
                      host_machine: "${CVM_HOST}"
                      cvm_name: "${CVM_NAME}"
                      ip: "${HOST_IP}"
                      port: "8000"
                      instance: "2"
              - job_name: dcgm-dcgm-glm52
                scrape_interval: 15s
                metrics_path: /metrics
                static_configs:
                  - targets: ['dcgm-glm52:9400']
                    labels:
                      service: "dcgm-exporter"
                      source: "dcgm-exporter"
                      container_name: "dcgm-glm52"
                      model: "PhalaCloud/GLM-5.2-W4AFP8"
                      deployment: "GLM-5.2-W4AFP8-SGL-2xTP4"
                      env: "${ENV}"
                      host: "${CVM_HOST}"
                      host_machine: "${CVM_HOST}"
                      cvm_name: "${CVM_NAME}"
                      ip: "${HOST_IP}"
                      port: "9400"
              - job_name: inference-proxy-proxy-glm52
                scrape_interval: 15s
                metrics_path: /metrics
                static_configs:
                  - targets: ['proxy-glm52:8000']
                    labels:
                      service: "vllm-proxy"
                      source: "vllm-proxy"
                      container_name: "proxy-glm52"
                      model: "z-ai/glm-5.2"
                      deployment: "GLM-5.2-W4AFP8-SGL-2xTP4"
                      env: "${ENV}"
                      host: "${CVM_HOST}"
                      host_machine: "${CVM_HOST}"
                      cvm_name: "${CVM_NAME}"
                      ip: "${HOST_IP}"
                      port: "8000"

        prometheus/self:
          config:
            scrape_configs:
              - job_name: otelcol-app
                scrape_interval: 30s
                static_configs:
                  - targets: ['localhost:8888']

      processors:
        memory_limiter:
          check_interval: 1s
          limit_mib: 512
          spike_limit_mib: 128

        resource:
          attributes:
            - key: host.name
              value: $${env:DD_HOSTNAME}
              action: upsert
            - key: cvm.name
              value: $${env:CVM_NAME}
              action: upsert
            - key: host.machine
              value: $${env:CVM_HOST}
              action: insert
            - key: deployment.environment
              value: $${env:ENV}
              action: upsert
            - key: service.namespace
              value: near-ai
              action: insert

        transform/docker_metadata:
          error_mode: ignore
          log_statements:
            - context: log
              statements:
                - set(attributes["service.name"], attributes["attrs"]["com.docker.compose.service"]) where attributes["attrs"] != nil and attributes["attrs"]["com.docker.compose.service"] != nil
                - set(attributes["service.name"], ParseJSON(attributes["attrs"]["com.datadoghq.ad.logs"])[0]["service"]) where attributes["attrs"] != nil and attributes["attrs"]["com.datadoghq.ad.logs"] != nil
                - set(attributes["log.source"], ParseJSON(attributes["attrs"]["com.datadoghq.ad.logs"])[0]["source"]) where attributes["attrs"] != nil and attributes["attrs"]["com.datadoghq.ad.logs"] != nil
                - set(attributes["service"], attributes["service.name"]) where attributes["attrs"] != nil and attributes["attrs"]["com.datadoghq.ad.logs"] != nil and attributes["service.name"] != nil
                - set(attributes["source"], attributes["log.source"]) where attributes["attrs"] != nil and attributes["attrs"]["com.datadoghq.ad.logs"] != nil and attributes["log.source"] != nil
                - set(attributes["container.name"], attributes["attrs"]["com.docker.compose.service"]) where attributes["attrs"] != nil and attributes["attrs"]["com.docker.compose.service"] != nil

        filter/app_logs:
          error_mode: ignore
          logs:
            log_record:
              - 'attributes["model"] == nil and attributes["deployment"] == nil'
              - 'attributes["service.name"] == "compose-manager"'
              - 'attributes["service.name"] == "compose-manager-launcher"'
              - 'attributes["service.name"] == "otelcol-management"'
              - 'attributes["service.name"] == "otelcol-contrib"'
              - 'attributes["service.name"] == "datadog-agent"'

        groupbyattrs/docker_service:
          keys:
            - service.name
            - service
            - container.name
            - log.source
            - source
            - log.iostream
            - model
            - model_path
            - precision
            - deployment
            - env
            - host
            - ip
            - port
            - instance
            - replica

        batch:
          send_batch_size: 1024
          send_batch_max_size: 2048
          timeout: 5s

      exporters:
        otlphttp/gateway:
          endpoint: https://telemetry.infra.near.ai
          headers:
            Authorization: "Bearer $${env:MONITORING_INGEST_TOKEN}"
          sending_queue:
            num_consumers: 1
            queue_size: 128
            storage: file_storage

      extensions:
        file_storage:
          directory: /var/lib/otelcol-contrib/storage
          create_directory: true

      service:
        extensions: [file_storage]
        pipelines:
          logs/app:
            receivers: [filelog/docker_containers]
            processors: [memory_limiter, resource, transform/docker_metadata, filter/app_logs, groupbyattrs/docker_service, batch]
            exporters: [otlphttp/gateway]
          metrics/app:
            receivers: [prometheus/apps]
            processors: [memory_limiter, resource, batch]
            exporters: [otlphttp/gateway]
          metrics/otlp:
            receivers: [otlp]
            processors: [memory_limiter, resource, batch]
            exporters: [otlphttp/gateway]
          metrics/self:
            receivers: [prometheus/self]
            processors: [memory_limiter, resource, batch]
            exporters: [otlphttp/gateway]
          traces:
            receivers: [otlp]
            processors: [memory_limiter, resource, batch]
            exporters: [otlphttp/gateway]
        telemetry:
          metrics:
            address: localhost:8888
          logs:
            level: info

  registrar_script:
    content: |
      #!/bin/sh
      PROXY_URL="https://completions.near.ai"
      TOKEN="$${MODEL_PROXY_TOKEN}"
      INFERENCE_TOKEN="$${PROXY_TOKEN}"

      if [ -z "$$TOKEN" ] || [ -z "$$INFERENCE_TOKEN" ]; then
        echo "ERROR: MODEL_PROXY_TOKEN and PROXY_TOKEN are required for model-proxy registration"
        exit 1
      fi

      ENDPOINT="$${HOST_IP}:$${HTTP_PORT}"
      REGISTERED=false
      FAILURE_COUNT=0
      MAX_RETRIES=3

      register_endpoint() {
        echo "Registering endpoint $$1 with routing port $$2"
        curl -sS --max-time 10 -X POST "$$PROXY_URL/register/endpoint" \
          -H "Authorization: Bearer $$TOKEN" \
          -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
          -d "{\"endpoint\":\"$$1\",\"routing_port\":$$2}"
      }

      unregister_endpoint() {
        echo "Unregistering endpoint $$1"
        curl -sS --max-time 10 -X POST "$$PROXY_URL/unregister/endpoint" \
          -H "Authorization: Bearer $$TOKEN" \
          -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
          -d "{\"endpoint\":\"$$1\"}"
      }

      register_model() {
        curl -sS --max-time 10 -X POST "$$PROXY_URL/register/model" \
          -H "Authorization: Bearer $$TOKEN" \
          -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
          -d "{\"model\":\"$$1\",\"domain\":\"$$2\"}"
      }

      cleanup() {
        echo "SIGTERM received, unregistering $$ENDPOINT"
        unregister_endpoint "$$ENDPOINT"
        REGISTERED=false
        exit 0
      }
      trap cleanup TERM INT

      mark_registered() {
        register_endpoint "$$ENDPOINT" "$${TLS_PORT}"
        register_model "z-ai/glm-5.2" "glm-5-2.completions.near.ai"
        if [ "$$REGISTERED" = false ]; then
          echo "[GLM-5.2-W4AFP8-SGL-2xTP4] Registered z-ai/glm-5.2 (2x AWQ TP4) at $$ENDPOINT"
        fi
        REGISTERED=true
      }

      # Readiness gate: probe the proxy pool via the host nginx port. The proxy's
      # backend_pool health-manages a/b at runtime, so the box is "ready" once the
      # path resolves; per-backend failover is handled downstream.
      check_inference() {
        echo "Performing health check on model endpoint..."
        status=$$(curl -sS --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 45 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" \
          -X POST "http://$${HOST_IP}:$${HTTP_PORT}/v1/chat/completions" \
          -H "Authorization: Bearer $$INFERENCE_TOKEN" \
          -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
          -d '{"model":"z-ai/glm-5.2","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}],"max_tokens":1}')
        curl_status=$$?

        if [ "$$curl_status" -ne 0 ]; then
          case "$$curl_status" in
            52|56)
              echo "[GLM-5.2-W4AFP8-SGL-2xTP4] Health probe hit connection-level backpressure (curl $$curl_status); treating as alive but saturated"
              return 2
              ;;
            28)
              # Probe timeout is NOT proof of death: a 1-token completion queues
              # behind long-context prefills and legitimately exceeds 45s under
              # prod load, with no 503/backpressure signal (observed 2026-07-08
              # on the TP8 hosts: 3 timeouts -> unregister -> exit flap cycle
              # while the engine served fine). Disambiguate with a fast
              # /v1/models probe - it answers from the HTTP layer even at full
              # queue depth, so 2xx means alive-but-saturated. Genuinely dead
              # backends still fail it and unregister; model-proxy's own
              # /healthz checker + breaker (PR#42) covers them within seconds
              # regardless.
              if curl -sf --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 10 \
                -H "Authorization: Bearer $$INFERENCE_TOKEN" \
                "http://$${HOST_IP}:$${HTTP_PORT}/v1/models" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
                echo "[GLM-5.2-W4AFP8-SGL-2xTP4] Health probe timed out but /v1/models is live; treating as alive but saturated"
                return 2
              fi
              echo "[GLM-5.2-W4AFP8-SGL-2xTP4] Health probe timed out and /v1/models is unreachable"
              return 1
              ;;
          esac
          echo "[GLM-5.2-W4AFP8-SGL-2xTP4] Health probe curl failed with status $$curl_status"
          return 1
        fi

        case "$$status" in
          2*)
            return 0
            ;;
          503)
            echo "[GLM-5.2-W4AFP8-SGL-2xTP4] Backend returned 503; treating as alive but saturated"
            return 2
            ;;
          *)
            echo "[GLM-5.2-W4AFP8-SGL-2xTP4] Backend returned HTTP $$status"
            return 1
            ;;
        esac
      }

      READY_URL="http://$${HOST_IP}:$${HTTP_PORT}/v1/models"
      echo "Waiting for model to be ready (probing $$READY_URL)..."
      ready_attempts=0
      until curl --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 10 -sf \
        -H "Authorization: Bearer $$INFERENCE_TOKEN" \
        "$$READY_URL" > /dev/null 2>&1; do
        ready_attempts=$$((ready_attempts + 1))
        if [ "$$ready_attempts" -ge 30 ]; then
          echo "WARN: model not reachable at $$READY_URL after $$ready_attempts attempts (~20m); entering registration loop anyway"
          break
        fi
        echo "Model not ready yet (attempt $$ready_attempts/30), retrying in 30s..."
        sleep 30
      done
      echo "Model ready, starting registration loop"

      while true; do
        date +%s > /tmp/registrar_alive
        check_inference
        health_status=$$?
        case "$$health_status" in
          0)
            FAILURE_COUNT=0
            mark_registered
            ;;
          2)
            FAILURE_COUNT=0
            echo "[GLM-5.2-W4AFP8-SGL-2xTP4] Keeping $$ENDPOINT registered while backend is saturated"
            mark_registered
            ;;
          *)
            FAILURE_COUNT=$$((FAILURE_COUNT + 1))
            echo "[GLM-5.2-W4AFP8-SGL-2xTP4] Health check failed ($$FAILURE_COUNT/$$MAX_RETRIES)"
            if [ "$$REGISTERED" = true ] && [ "$$FAILURE_COUNT" -ge "$$MAX_RETRIES" ]; then
              echo "[GLM-5.2-W4AFP8-SGL-2xTP4] Retry limit reached, unregistering $$ENDPOINT"
              unregister_endpoint "$$ENDPOINT"
              REGISTERED=false
              echo "[GLM-5.2-W4AFP8-SGL-2xTP4] Exiting to refresh DNS (container will auto-restart)"
              exit 1
            fi
            ;;
        esac
        sleep 60
      done
  nginx_conf:
    content: |
      log_format json_combined escape=json
        '{'  '"time":"$$time_iso8601"'
        ',"request_id":"$$http_x_request_id"'
        ',"org_id":"$$http_x_org_id"'
        ',"workspace_id":"$$http_x_workspace_id"'
        ',"http_host":"$$host"'
        ',"method":"$$request_method"'
        ',"uri":"$$uri"'
        ',"status":$$status'
        ',"request_length":$$request_length'
        ',"bytes_sent":$$bytes_sent'
        ',"request_time":$$request_time'
        ',"upstream_addr":"$$upstream_addr"'
        '}';

      server {
          listen 80 default_server;
          access_log /var/log/nginx/access.log json_combined;
          client_max_body_size 100m;
          client_body_buffer_size 1m;
          location / {
              proxy_pass http://proxy-glm52:8000;
              proxy_http_version 1.1;
              proxy_set_header Host $$host;
              proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $$remote_addr;
              proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $$proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
              proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $$scheme;
              proxy_set_header Connection '';
              proxy_buffering off;
              proxy_cache off;
              proxy_read_timeout 3600s;
          }
      }

      server {
          listen 443 ssl http2;
          server_name glm-5-2.completions.near.ai;
          ssl_certificate /etc/letsencrypt/live/completions.near.ai/fullchain.pem;
          ssl_certificate_key /etc/letsencrypt/live/completions.near.ai/privkey.pem;
          ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;
          keepalive_timeout 1h;
          keepalive_requests 1000000;
          access_log /var/log/nginx/access.log json_combined;
          client_max_body_size 100m;
          client_body_buffer_size 1m;
          location ^~ /metrics { return 404; }
          location ^~ /v1/metrics { return 404; }
          location / {
              proxy_pass http://proxy-glm52:8000;
              proxy_http_version 1.1;
              proxy_set_header Host $$host;
              proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $$remote_addr;
              proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $$proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
              proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $$scheme;
              proxy_set_header Connection '';
              proxy_buffering off;
              proxy_cache off;
              proxy_read_timeout 3600s;
          }
      }

source: nearai/cvm-compose-files at each commit the 2026-11-08 glm-5-3-flash log (conformance/nearai-trust/actions-a0e3c6f4f21a-2026-11-08T1231Z.json) names, each hash-checked against the log's file_sha256. services: the service names of every logged (commit, file), parsed like fleet_drift.service_names; bodies: the running revisions of that log and of the gpu04 fixture log that the kit's compose-files lacks.
